**And how -- HOW -- did the Left convince them this was empowerment? **

"Girlboss" feminism.

Exploitation dressed up as "liberation."

But I don't believe women are broken... _or hopelessly lost to the Left... _

I just believe they've been lied to.

**And that 's why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit 2026 (WLS) matters now more than ever. **

body:
Hi there,
After serving our country for 35 years in the Navy, I was removed from my position by Pete Hegseth without reason.
I spent my entire life in service to this country, always putting the mission and the people above myself. But when I was forced out, I had a choice: go out quietly, or find a way to keep serving.
I’ve always lived by three simple ideals: honor, integrity, and respect. That’s why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s first district. If you believe that’s what we need in Washington right now, please consider splitting $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
The day I was removed from my position, I was forced to leave behind my life’s work. I never went back to the Pentagon or wore the uniform again.
But this story isn’t just about me. Throughout the first year of Donald Trump’s second term, every woman serving as a three or four-star admiral in the Navy has been fired, forced out, or reassigned. This wasn’t an isolated incident. It’s a pattern.
When leadership decisions are driven by politics instead of integrity, our families, communities, and nation pay the price.
That’s why I’m running for Congress: to keep serving, to stand up when it’s hardest, and to fight for leadership that puts country over politics every time.
Early support in races like this matters most. We have a long road ahead of us if we’re going to fill this open seat and make the government work for the people again. If you can, please split $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to help me hit the ground running and prove that service to our country shouldn’t end just because someone in power says it should. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. My NIL bill is straightforward. As a player, you get to play for five consecutive seasons with one free transfer. If you choose to transfer a second time or more, you have to sit out a year. I’ve spent 35 years of my life dealing with the NCAA and coaching in college football. I can say with 100% certainty – the situation is a MESS right now. We’ve got to start somewhere. | We all love college sports. Whether it’s college football and the CFP, college basketball and March Madness, or any other sport that a whole bunch of us grew up playing. But as long as NIL money and the transfer portal go unchecked, we’ll never have real competition. Thank you, Coach Tuberville Meet Coach Tuberville: Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Friend,

We have some potentially game-changing news in our race.

**The Sacramento Bee Editorial Board just announced they will NOT be endorsing my opponent, Doris Matsui — who has represented CA-07 for the past 20 years.**

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquO38L98SklfBdoDq94y0bmIPp1sMsxRlzUR9IaKq2v2k_H8mQgPOgN1vNc4J8gVpL3b8xwF_0FATkbsGevOUJKYZj_sFGhXXFSiM1PSAB9uZJ7q16jzRNRpPAZBEbRx37jnXMgdPFeWJ9tHGTxZbh0AjMTfSpszVuouNnd4ONFJETc5aZAZcvtpHzhHJVtCR8MGRyUx-I9UQyyL781rmcYqaTiBcsU_JDK_fa4u3ZWPcwujGiaLJYJ2KY46vwjaGQbmCdCiDfo0lYKW1QHCMkdHl8il95oSbFpD-UwPxuG2uZiyT4oiKqeel7oCoShqT-MWHabtiQqajM6fCsgkEsE1sW7W0pKOyTByYG3lUYUcg/4pl/nUpUOHMVTH-X3iVZTYMFWg/h1/h001.k2WIlhXJEj0MxUdlumqHGG-e4c-Fo6nIbg5-HrXPGn4)
The Bee called Matsui’s refusal to meet for a debate or interview — “a step backward in local democracy and election transparency.”

Think about this for a second.

For two decades, Doris eagerly accepted the Bee's endorsement. Now that she has a real challenger, she's refusing to answer questions, show up, and be accountable.

This June, there is a real contrast on the ballot:
* A campaign funded by corporate PACs vs. one powered by people
* Incrementalism vs. having the urgency to take on ICE, corporate influence, and fight for Medicare for All
* Refusing to call out the genocide in Gaza vs. having the courage to speak truth to power

We hope you and your families had a joyful and blessed Easter!
On my way back to Washington DC for the shutdown, I stopped in New York to do Fox & Friends on Sunday morning. We discussed the situation in Iran and the heroic rescue of our downed airman from enemy territory. It was good to be able to highlight the role that Fairchild Air Force Base plays in providing SERE (Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape) training which gives airmen the tools they need to come home safely in challenging circumstances.

name: info@luceroforcongress.com
subject: From RFK Jr.’s inner circle… to Congress?
body:
Last Thursday, Rob Lucero, Democratic candidate for U.S. Congress in Los Angeles, appeared live on The Sharpe Way podcast for a wide-ranging interview with host Larry Sharpe, New York political figure and Libertarian candidate for governor. Rob shared a number of things that are quite unique.

| | |
---
Hi Peter, Last Thursday, Rob Lucero, Democratic candidate for U.S. Congress in Los Angeles, appeared live on _The Sharpe Way_ podcast for a wide-ranging interview with host Larry Sharpe, New York political figure and Libertarian candidate for governor. Rob shared a number of things that are quite unique. Rob was **employee #001** on Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s presidential campaign. He was there at the very beginning, helping shape what became a national movement. And now he is carrying that mission forward in his own race for Congress. In this interview, Rob touches on several ideas that you are not hearing from typical candidates: He talks about what it means to be a “Kennedy Democrat” today, rooted in the tradition of John F. Kennedy. Politics centered on building the country, advancing science, restoring industry, and ending the forever wars. He lays out a bold vision for rebuilding America’s infrastructure using the same principles championed by Alexander Hamilton and later revived under Abraham Lincoln. As Rob has said on other occasions, it’s a **plan for creating 25 million new well-paid industrial jobs that AI can’t do.** Rob speaks candidly about why so many Americans are losing faith in both parties, and why independent voices are rising across the country. And he gave a recent example in which Congress passed a law within 24 hours, and the president signed it a day later. So, government can still act decisively when it wants to. There is much more in this conversation, including Rob’s thoughts on homelessness, national service, and how the United States can once again become a nation that builds for the future. You owe it to yourself to hear it directly from him. 👉**[Watch Video Here](https://www.luceroforcongress.com/r?u=oyBBfpvh8M3kjvMCbssAuwc3w3MH-xuT4wmZ2gUKyeEU-OKKP46spBqbgTLZ7zTEdg_ZQs0p564_4lwW16z8Hg&e=39cdcb2fb7adda80e7fc66430579bb85&utm_source=luceroforcongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rob_on_the_sharpe_way&n=1)** After you’ve watched, I think you’ll understand why this campaign is gaining momentum, and why we need Rob Lucero in Congress. If you’re able to support this effort, now is the time. 👉 [**Watch**](https://www.luceroforcongress.com/r?u=oyBBfpvh8M3kjvMCbssAuwc3w3MH-xuT4wmZ2gUKyeEU-OKKP46spBqbgTLZ7zTEdg_ZQs0p564_4lwW16z8Hg&e=39cdcb2fb7adda80e7fc66430579bb85&utm_source=luceroforcongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rob_on_the_sharpe_way&n=2) **Please support the campaign with a financial contribution. The election is in June, so we’re in a countdown.** Thank you for standing with us. **Team Lucero**

**Rob Lucero****
**Candidate for U.S. Congress – CA-34
“Country before party. People before politics.” info@luceroforcongress.com

name: Rose Penelope Yee
subject: I'm sick and tired of war.
body:
Let me be clear: I completely oppose Israel's invasion of Lebanon and condemn the declarations by Israeli officials to seize southern Lebanon.

| | | | | [|
---](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=06519cb92e&e=8c53948e4c)
| | | | | |
# Another war?
---
| |
Friends,
Like the majority of Americans, I am sick and tired of wars.
**So let me be clear: I completely oppose Israel's invasion of Lebanon and condemn the declarations by Israeli officials to permanently seize southern Lebanon. I reject any U.S. involvement or support for this illegal invasion.**
The participation of U.S. forces or the use of military aid to facilitate the occupation is a betrayal of the principles of self-determination and global stability. Any U.S. military action, continued sharing of intelligence, or the continued flow of heavy weaponry from the U.S. to Israel will only further destabilize the region, poison the environment, destroy families, and increase energy costs back home in our communities.
**Our Congressional Representative should be leading on this issue, but so far, he has not made a statement in opposition to the invasion. Nor has he signed on as a co-sponsor to the bills in Congress that could put a stop to U.S. participation in Israel’s** _****_**illegal war on Lebanon. Our District deserves better.**
[**Can you send our campaign a few dollars so we can finish the primary strong and ensure a real PEACE candidate is on the ballot in November?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=2b5ce7e9c8&e=8c53948e4c)
**If elected to Congress, I will support and cosponsor legislation calling for an immediate ceasefire, an end to any U.S. participation in the illegal war, and an embargo on all weapons shipments to Israel.**
We need representatives who understand that a truly secure America is one that invests in its people — in healthcare, housing, education, and climate resilience — not one that expands conflict abroad while communities struggle at home. That’s what the Rose Doctrine is all about: putting people, peace, and the planet first.

subject: 2026 April e-newsletter
body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/eb384849a421/2026april-e-newsletter?e=c0babbc643)

|

| | | | | **2026 April e-newsletter**
####
---
|
* Women of Excellence honored during Women’s History Month
* Without stable funding, severe cuts coming to Caltrain
* Interpretive Pavilion at San Bruno Mountain Park taking shape
* ‘No Kings’ rallies spark historic call to action

---
| | |
---
|
# “At the very moment local governments are losing tens of millions in state funding, they’re now being asked to absorb another $20 million hit.”
# **\- Supervisor David Canepa**
---
| | | | **2026 April e-newsletter** **‘No Kings’ rallies spark historic call to action** Dear friends, I was proud to speak at a “No Kings” rally at County Center in Redwood City Saturday, March 28, part of a wave of coordinated events held across the country calling for the protection of democratic norms and institutions. At the Redwood City rally, I spoke about the growing alarm over efforts to undermine elections, attacks on the independence of the courts and the press and rhetoric that many believe threatens the rule of law. I emphasized that the United States is built on the principle that no one is above the law and that power ultimately rests with the people. Participants pointed to concerns about election interference, the war in Iran and the spread of misinformation and broader challenges to democratic institutions as key reasons for organizing. The rally reflected a broader national conversation about accountability, civic engagement and the need to safeguard democratic values at every level of government. I believe this moment represents a historic call to action. People across the country are speaking out because they understand what is at stake. We cannot take our democracy for granted. It is up to all of us to stay engaged, to stand up for the rule of law and to make sure our government remains accountable to the people it serves.
**Interpretive Pavilion at San Bruno Mountain Park taking shape** San Mateo County Parks is getting closer to opening a new Interpretive Pavilion and picnic area at San Bruno Mountain Park in late spring and you can really start to see it come together. The new pavilion and restroom facility will sit right in the day-use area, creating a central hub for visitors to gather, learn and connect with the natural environment. We’ve also added new picnic tables in the open space nearby, giving families, students, and community groups a comfortable place to sit, eat and take in the views. These $2 million in improvements are designed to make the park more welcoming, accessible and educational for everyone who visits. This project is about more than upgrades, it’s about creating a space where people can learn about our local ecosystems, enjoy the outdoors and build community right here in San Mateo County. I am looking forward to seeing this space come to life soon and cannot wait to welcome the community to enjoy this new enhanced outdoor recreational space. **Without stable funding, severe cuts coming to Caltrain** Caltrain is facing serious potential service cuts without a new, stable funding source and the impacts would be felt across San Mateo County. Despite strong ridership growth and high customer satisfaction, Caltrain could be forced to eliminate weekend service, reduce trains to once an hour, close stations, and end service early. That would mean more traffic, more pollution, and fewer transportation options for working families. Caltrain is essential to our economy and quality of life. It keeps people moving, supports local businesses, and reduces congestion on Highway 101. We need to work together regionally to secure long-term funding and protect this vital service for the residents and communities who depend on it every day. What makes this especially concerning is that Caltrain is actually succeeding. Ridership is up significantly, and the new electrified system is delivering faster, cleaner, and more reliable service. Cutting service now would reverse that progress and undermine the very investments we’ve made to modernize transit on the Peninsula. There is a path forward. A regional funding measure could stabilize Caltrain’s finances and ensure continued service, but it will require public support. This is a critical moment to invest in a system that is working and to protect a service that is vital to our environment, our economy, and our future. **Women of Excellence honored during Women’s History Month** I want to commend the Daly City Women’s Commission for honoring 12 Women of Excellence during Women’s History Month at a special event at City Hall March 19. Special thanks to my wife Ana Valenzuela for standing in my place to present commendations to the honorees and a special proclamation to the Women’s Commission. The Women’s Commission serves as an advisory body to the City Council with the mission to improve the quality of life for women of all ages in Daly City by identifying women’s needs, making policy and program recommendations to the City Council and educating the community on matters concerning women. The Women of Excellence honorees this year are Marie Villarosa, Patricia deVera and Shirley Chan. The Youth Women of Excellence are Jesslelynn Tran, Jasmine Castro, Estephanie Sente Guardia, Amnah Qayed, Azna Kyria Madu and Ayanna Rae Hernandez. The Kapwa Kultural Center and its founders Stephanie Balon and Chrisi Morales-Kumasawa, pictured above with Ana Valenzuela (photo courtesy of Patrick M. Gee), were honored as the Woman Community-Based Organization and finally Francine Kendrea Lucero was honored as the Commission’s Woman Warrior. Congratulations to all the winners!

**Landmark affordable housing project clears another hurdle** The landmark 72-unit affordable housing project on Eastmoor Avenue in Daly City cleared another hurdle in March as the Board of Supervisors provided notice of a Surplus Land Act exemption to the California Department of Housing and Community Development which paves the way for the project to move forward. In November, the County officially purchased the property at 493 Eastmoor Ave. for $4.4 million, unlocking the path to building 72 units of 100% affordable housing for households earning 20%–50% of the area median income. These homes won’t just serve today’s families; they’ll remain affordable for nearly a century, creating stability for generations. Our county should be extraordinarily proud of identifying and investing in this transit-rich, community-centered project. This is exactly the kind of bold action that prevents displacement, keeps families housed, and stops homelessness before it starts. By purchasing the property, we’re enabling the developer to secure the tax credits and financing necessary to bring this project to life. And the best part? No new funds were required. The $4.4 million was already allocated as part of our commitment to affordable housing. Now, with county ownership and a long-term lease in place, 55 years with an option for 44 more, we are ensuring long-term affordability and long-term stability. In friendship,
**DAVID J. CANEPA**
San Mateo County Board of Supervisors

## Trump Holds Iran to Deadline
President Trump reiterated [his threats against Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQBuCnwRsRPsDYA0Olyluqbh0tAuf4KgwRkER5-8qV-gSd7_Tr__6v83J2FCldP9yOtq15SfisEVvDslBxKaALkRLu5De6uvSkVNMCAgYuFBdmCY7ia1FdsCsioOzQ9sZorQetdbdZ72DslREXAG3AD-Oo5UWuo1ajV873HdkjTShheiGmXp4gTH4Y0Ktp1CNME1MCA7VcTt-ZUttwja_8wHLyee-i3Vq7VSbfGMwMZnfxh-C4MZg_c6RGvjKYW7nvN77lGPjxwH1OKxZMHrmjsrvEC1Z_R_4n5gefwVxbLi8mZwpMvveyN4PSoLtiw-1JMVIdDFPiujuKv43av2Z8WPgJAAD__-RRhjg) on Monday, warning in a White House speech of strikes on bridges and power plants if Tehran doesn't reopen the Strait of Hormuz by tonight's 8 p.m. ET deadline. Iran rejected [a 45-day ceasefire proposal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAUhJ_G7rD4JxQUt3GX225pETiOT4TBAjZW3n7lfYXtRhppRt_3dV_uHhPm53-_g-trWTKcLUHvUBesPkfwMWGGHcOGT59PzC0vnHJNqCTULNFj-ixyjG4F4CBGcMwYpZRWSo2bE9owRh9UrF7YcAteSy5EjBAfwajwGNFda1RSwyi1TEw82qA1BGlv6satHSSFiL3U6VUw9w3W9ClvqFMo-5jc1vvRBvFv4PPA5_M8p4_fSrnagc8XzsBnXzuGBFe8qEiFF4TeSADfYMUK5KjlKM0n8t0IE9RIZrWYtr6nsbp4nJgSNm0GSZ-7x_R73v9k7O34TwAAAP___8R__w) on Monday, demanding a permanent end to hostilities with guarantees against future attacks instead. Tehran communicated its response through Pakistani mediators. Meanwhile, Israel said it [killed two](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OnTAQBeCngc5Xxn9AQREput2mTYnMzACT65-N7SzZt4_IK2x7jnSk7_x8W988B07HDx9paXteE101UGtUVi4-IXkMnCgynHz4dHGqaVVSOSGNkOOKnsPnanpcdiJFuqdlGEdrrbPW9ueiJquQQMEMhGayoDdj_ODlOMlBbabn5V6TRo6DlPOgHwpncI7AzJOd1Dx3RhJyy-XxK3NqJ-3hM39QeUCOfVjO1t5rp7916tmp53Vdjz3_vRV3fye5BOzUk3EXkNPOJVbB5QDBqVEQcDLt4sUhEIrff7CKPRcgATnG21-EDzULChw5-UYoaiv8ok4_Y83wYuz0d6ntOG3TNsA8Otic1NrNNNCAHh1q35cF3y8OgasbOyOP6Dn8B7Qvvf6xqH8BAAD__x-vl00) senior Iranian Revolutionary Guard figures: intelligence chief Maj. Gen. Majid Khademi and Quds Force undercover unit leader Asghar Bakeri. Trump also praised the [weekend rescue](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdCDfYmMoXKShu7Qp0WKvj42MORnn0P195PxCuhmN9KQ3X_fljhw5PT5xJ1vCsSS6zkilUF44Y_KEPnKind3GD0wXpzMtIGFopWqlWTxyfC-q8TYQAfUN2ZsxWutBa91s1gTA1YRehTAiOgwTjbIPK7p1AOh1w7bSpJLmJuV06zvwkxsGcmoa9QjTJJQkz-XI3ffBqWwU4vt4Ue7csTfRbqU8T9F_CJgFzNd1dW49q0XdBcw1CphL_tmfbS2tO1KgTMlRWxUFzE22_nlxjHwORij52JHjH7_865SXhd8AAAD___3kdyk) of a U.S. weapons system officer downed inside Iran, calling the complex operation, involving over 150 aircraft and 200 munitions, an "amazing show of bravery." He said military members would join him at the White House.
## Michigan Beats UConn for National Title
Michigan basketball won its second national championship last night, beating [UConn 69-63](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZEZNY8w4cHAJ2Vx6IfLZDfTKmJHxjsXfr1hpv2CTSkp6qnr_nvPTceS0_nU72bIcc6J6RiqF8szZpUAuRE60s994dalyOtOMgFqCkjDOwXG8ZtUEuxAh9Q3ZbhyHYdDDMDSbXR4UADuFwRhCbcJ_9DhqBNK9AzAN25sGCsYOwHR9i8F4rckr8xgeaIxQQIHLkduPg1PZaInX8abc-mNvot1KeZ2i_yNwEjjVWtta01Xedy1wuuECJ1B3jAKn5J2ThUskubqd5M8zWTLTKQNlx1F--iMlGa7kznIJnJpsw6tyjHzqUShYd8fxe0H5lba3xa8AAAD___ZdgAk) at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis to end a 37-year title drought. It's a coronation moment for Wolverines head coach Dusty May, who turned the program into a title champion just two years into his tenure. It was [Michigan's defense](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAQx58GOw1yALWg2IbubLulGWE8zi6CAc4xvv3Gm9wnuM3MFL_M_-PPc34CBYqv37CjqWuaI54lYK2YZ8oQPYIPFHEnt9EL4kmxxFlwoVsuWz7MHihcs2y8WREFPho0_TAopbRSqtnMwjkotTi_Oq11L7xcF6c1rsOoNYJsyNzfuORDz_nUPzrhpxtwchrVKKaJSY6easrd30SxbriGK30wdy7tTTBbrUdhj19MWCbseZ7du0BNHq4bYMKWmvJ17yPlWpiw0QEsTNhblwnL5T3u6-1SjO131DZCpRQhtG6D_aAUy0ZHW1zK2C5Q_mFdIAQm7DjJqZe95nxgwjbZ-OOkEKjogUn-2oHCl9n6o4Y_RvwPAAD__3RWjnk) that carried them to the title. The Wolverines held UConn to 63 points, the Huskies' second-lowest scoring output of the entire tournament. When UConn tried to slow the game to a grind, Michigan's physicality--combined with a cool 19 points by [Most Outstanding Player Elliot Cadeau](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuu3DAMRVcjdxpwZMmfwkUady9tSoOR6DEDWTIkzjO8-8ADZAVpSBbEuRfn19fyhRw5vX7iTpOseUl01kgiVBYumAJhiJxoZ7_xC9PJqabFgOk0WA39EpDjtdgmTCuRobah6dn3zrnOOddsk_N2BFrd4EPo26F9WujX4LsBVnTOmoanmwYW-ifA-GwfJoy-68jbcXCDGUdlgQJLLo8_mZNstMYrf1N5-Lw3cdpEjqraH8rMyszneT7eFSUHvO4HZeYquVz3PnKRqsycPOJvZeY7V5kZ7D3ui2LkLNpjIHzrPVfR-S1VMAVOL31EvKjofyr0jsVveseQqFZdBT_0YbSjAWgBemXmpkzhODlGrl2vLLx25PhpLv-l-3syfwMAAP__IIWSpQ)--ultimately won out, but not before a tense final minute where UConn pulled to within four points. Michigan had been [0-4 in title games](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu3CAURVeDOywGgzEFRRq6nzalxfCe7ZdgsAwz1uw-cqSs4NdHurrn_PqavwIlyuvPsKNrS5kzXjVha3jOdIYMGCBRxp3iRmvIF-WaZynkyIXiwswQKH1m1YFbECUOHbqHMVrrUWvdbW6ZlIVhASHM01iwRuhRGWExGsBBQUfuXhNKmIcQ9jH0EmwcR4zKTnqS1jIlEKiVs_9dKLcNl_Qpbzz7WPYuua21o7LhB5OeSX9dV4_1yDdk0u-YK48lJVyRP0P9g-0ZUmLS11bOD5N-ZtITMOnVpIRV0jLpcwyBxy3sB5VcNzr4f33-iiVnfpwIFNtNeaI38tcBoWHlt0p3OjguSonqaJgS6x4o_TvbvlX47eTfAAAA__-pZ5Ac) since its last championship in 1989, a drought that included two Fab Five runner-up finishes and losses in 2013 and 2018. Last night, Dusty May etched his name alongside the all-time greats in Ann Arbor.
## Ranking: America's Tallest Buildings
A new ranking of the [20 tallest buildings in America](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQRp8GOpBx_IMLF7ehy223RBN7DLM7mAg7QXn7VfIKW3-fzpHO13W-AjHl5T9s6Gva54xnYawVj5kOyBEhMmXcKKy0QD4plzxLIU0nVCfsHIH4Nas2-oQo8dKiH6zVWhutdbt6gwGSSlIJK0cnYwxBuTSkYE2A8YYt-TdNKGEHIdxw6WV0wRgMyo16lM41SmCkuh_99065rpj4tT_x6MO-tezXWu-lufxr5NTI6TzP_knlARzgThWYSn0fGzkdkH8wdnXFrgIzltrdHsSR8lI6yp_hURo5tYeP95OYqRjbKLFsQPyx1T8lenr5GwAA___kSny5) shows New York and Chicago still dominate the skyline, claiming 14 of the top 20 spots between them. One World Trade Center holds the top spot at 1,776 feet, followed by Central Park Tower at 1,550, which is also the [tallest residential building in the world](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUgOGnwVsiOAYTBoa7ZMtdO6JTOI5PiyECFCtvX7V9hO6_vuF_u4UbcuZy_487-bHWUOjomcagFrhhSYQpc6Gd48Z3LAeXXgJIWE5Sn6QNCTm_gp6SX4mA5om8stYYsxhjps07aSEqs2qHCi7vNiqwekWHTsaUnJnYf2tSS6ukdGo-Q3JxWShqdzEXcE5oSYlHbeePymVstOZXfVI7x7pP2W9jPLqY_wm4CrhGKqNhfmD7HPX4jQRcG3VOVCJ1ATOXQY1r61Pz6XFwztwXK7S878j5hx1_evH08BUAAP__K2tzqg). **Good morning!** On this day in 1886, one of the biggest gun battles in the history of the American West broke out on the day after a city election in Laredo, with [16 reported dead](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2SgyAUxfGnwU7n8iWhoNjGLttu6YBclR0iGbwT49vvmFfY6l-dX3F-7uPdp5y25ds_0NF7LuOGx56RCOv4W8JSy0Ervp84EUafQ9pKyKMA0begWjBj9Cmfo2qiCxAtb9BxY7TWtremWR0Y22OUN99bK0He5kkgj3b2k9ACpGqSuzBQYDgHLlVnhAZQIUSvuZ65YAowJiq1oxUJ336f81leWLupPJrsVqLnzuQXEwMTw3EcHe2rL1tOG3alLkwMn1Ub_dmG8woTA25Ur0qrmuri80g5p703TMHy8Cl_cPrfJS8n_gIAAP__MyN1Eg), though unofficial reports said the number may have been higher. Country song _Choosin' Texas_ has hit its fifth week as #1 on the charts. What makes you choose Texas? Reply to this email to let us know. | |
Friends,

I've been called a lot of things over the years, but "extreme" might be the most out-of-touch yet.
That's the label the [Democrat Attorneys General Association](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gmWpNrEwRdvwaPVXFK-RwmGMo14Tpr81SNhxc56dMKqrVgl9VNjz1ZCJ88CUg1UxaOMo5BgqSVZjDGykgMqFJlCdxkbzX10b6y4NfmGlMJs3In4gLMGaP1Nta2EyP7xXCb0GvNkcesFem8nPsU-1oycJeoohi4MYyX1it5KIxQCQ0gGWTYDOJPAYJ11Ais1Lea_5E1ks8mqGlCWcW3xpo5JesAJPVNksBrchNg6ImDo=&c=Y2jAF6cUzhhzmlwy1AUkV-GW9Ufz8y68vsf5P7xg5FLsPzbKn7-l6w==&ch=XnU2ZdyxKbIbB74Nvs7VJ6_CkoG5OZ1xYP3kxWWdc3OgRGJFvu5zyg==) is trying to stick on me. Not because of anything I've done, but because they don't have anything real to run against.
When they can't attack your record, they fall back on recycled talking points.
From day one, I've said it clearly: they don't want to face us in November because they know we can win this race.
And now they're proving it.
Here's the truth. I'm running to:
• End lawfare and restore fairness to our legal system • Protect your constitutional rights • Bring integrity back to the Attorney General's office
If that's what they call "extreme," it says a lot more about them than it does about us.
But make no mistake, these attacks are just the beginning.
They will spend millions trying to distort the truth, define this race, and hold onto power. We already know their nominee will be heavily funded and backed by national groups.
That means we need to be ready now.
If you believe Michigan deserves an Attorney General who will stand up for the rule of law and fight for its citizens, [I'm asking you to step up today](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gmWpNrEwRdvwaPVXFK-RwmGMo14Tpr81SNhxc56dMKqrVgl9VNjz1Q-3Ratp01eqyMwc1ESNw9pqKtI_Ose2hhRfpuelhvuu3u7EedAzZFEz8bJnDMuWDPM3-kHIvxZTrbifg6IKOEx36-QEPW1y5AyO1H-4CpGP997AwqyKqByF3ERhX2cUnfkLmZA8s1oaaNNsU3RhIzOANoJBMkjlkSRymsZkHIHY&c=Y2jAF6cUzhhzmlwy1AUkV-GW9Ufz8y68vsf5P7xg5FLsPzbKn7-l6w==&ch=XnU2ZdyxKbIbB74Nvs7VJ6_CkoG5OZ1xYP3kxWWdc3OgRGJFvu5zyg==).
Chip in [$10](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gmWpNrEwRdvwaPVXFK-RwmGMo14Tpr81SNhxc56dMKqrVgl9VNjz1Q-3Ratp01eqyMwc1ESNw9pqKtI_Ose2hhRfpuelhvuu3u7EedAzZFEz8bJnDMuWDPM3-kHIvxZTrbifg6IKOEx36-QEPW1y5AyO1H-4CpGP997AwqyKqByF3ERhX2cUnfkLmZA8s1oaaNNsU3RhIzOANoJBMkjlkUQOER83DJAA&c=Y2jAF6cUzhhzmlwy1AUkV-GW9Ufz8y68vsf5P7xg5FLsPzbKn7-l6w==&ch=XnU2ZdyxKbIbB74Nvs7VJ6_CkoG5OZ1xYP3kxWWdc3OgRGJFvu5zyg==), [$25](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gmWpNrEwRdvwaPVXFK-RwmGMo14Tpr81SNhxc56dMKqrVgl9VNjz1Q-3Ratp01eqyMwc1ESNw9pqKtI_Ose2hhRfpuelhvuu3u7EedAzZFEz8bJnDMuWDPM3-kHIvxZTrbifg6IKOEx36-QEPW1y5AyO1H-4CpGP997AwqyKqByF3ERhX2cUnfkLmZA8s1oaaNNsU3RhIzOANoJBMkjlkYSByj2lHROS&c=Y2jAF6cUzhhzmlwy1AUkV-GW9Ufz8y68vsf5P7xg5FLsPzbKn7-l6w==&ch=XnU2ZdyxKbIbB74Nvs7VJ6_CkoG5OZ1xYP3kxWWdc3OgRGJFvu5zyg==), or whatever you can to help us fight back and win in November.
[DONATE TODAY!](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gmWpNrEwRdvwaPVXFK-RwmGMo14Tpr81SNhxc56dMKqrVgl9VNjz1Q-3Ratp01eqyMwc1ESNw9pqKtI_Ose2hhRfpuelhvuu3u7EedAzZFEz8bJnDMuWDPM3-kHIvxZTrbifg6IKOEx36-QEPW1y5AyO1H-4CpGP997AwqyKqByF3ERhX2cUnfkLmZA8s1oaaNNsU3RhIzOANoJBMkjlkX5-rV44YylM&c=Y2jAF6cUzhhzmlwy1AUkV-GW9Ufz8y68vsf5P7xg5FLsPzbKn7-l6w==&ch=XnU2ZdyxKbIbB74Nvs7VJ6_CkoG5OZ1xYP3kxWWdc3OgRGJFvu5zyg==)

#
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Contact:**
Michael Biundo
michael@ascent-strategic.com
[LilyTangWilliams.com](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=a363b30bb6&e=c338950e03)

**Lily Tang Williams Calls for Immediate Federal Gas Tax Freeze
to Deliver Relief at the Pump for New Hampshire Drivers**

Weare, NH – April 7, 2026 – Republican candidate for Congress Lily Tang Williams today demanded an immediate temporary suspension of the federal gas tax, providing New Hampshire families and small businesses with urgent, pocketbook relief as pump prices hover near $3.90 per gallon, with diesel averaging approximately $5.80 per gallon in New Hampshire.

New Hampshire families are already grappling with some of the highest home energy prices in the country, paying an average residential electricity rate of 26.32 cents per kilowatt-hour, which is 51% higher than the national average of 17.45 cents per kWh (January 2026 EIA data).

With the current average price of regular gasoline in New Hampshire at approximately $3.87 to $3.92 per gallon and the national average now exceeding $4 for the first time in nearly four years, Williams is calling on Congress to freeze the 18.4-cent-per-gallon federal gas tax through at least October 1, 2026.

“I fled communism and came to America for freedom and opportunity,” said Williams. “But Granite State families today are being squeezed at the pump, forced to choose between filling their tanks and feeding their kids. Enough is enough. A federal gas tax freeze will deliver real, immediate relief, about 18 cents off every gallon, without raising taxes or growing government.”

Williams emphasized that this short-term freeze must be paired with long-term solutions: slashing wasteful federal spending that fuels inflation and pursuing an all-of-the-above American energy strategy to increase domestic production and lower prices permanently.

“While Congresswoman Goodlander voted against the bipartisan SPEED Act (H.R. 4776) and the PERMIT Act, commonsense permitting reforms that would have fast-tracked American energy projects and cut red tape to bring down costs, I will fight to pass these bills and unleash American oil, natural gas, nuclear power, and reliable energy so we never face these price spikes again,” Williams stated.

The move comes as working families, seniors on fixed incomes, and small business owners across New Hampshire’s 2nd District report feeling the pain of higher fuel costs that ripple through groceries, heating bills, and everyday expenses.

Lily Tang Williams, born and raised in the Peoples Republic of China, a survivor of Mao’s Cultural Revolution, came to the U.S. legally at age of 23 with only $100 in search of freedom and opportunity. name: Jim Jordan
subject: No one should ever accuse you of being a Democrat
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Patriot!
| Patriot,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

# Help Us Spotlight Schools Getting It Wrong (Or Right!)
|
---
|
---
| As the school year wraps up, TFVC is relaunching our “Wall of Shame” and “Wall of Praise” campaigns. Our **“Wall of Shame”** highlights some of the more **egregious misrepresentations of exemption laws** , where families are misled, key information is omitted, or unnecessary barriers are implied. As a result, many families encounter messaging that downplays or obscures exemption options, or suggests that items like class schedules or supply lists are contingent on shot records alone. **The good news?** Some schools are finally getting the message! As important as it is to call out those who misrepresent exemption laws, it’s just as essential to recognize those that **clearly and accurately communicate families’ rights** and enrollment options. Our **“Wall of Praise”** exists to do exactly that. **Now we need your help.** Have you encountered a school that deserves to be called out or one that deserves our applause? Send us screenshots, links, or details so we can **feature them on our Wall of Shame or Wall of Praise.** Together, we can hold institutions accountable and ensure every Texas family has the full picture on **vaccine enrollment policies.** **P.S.** Thanks to a recently passed TFVC priority bill, parents can now **print vaccine exemptions for enrollment from home**! No more online requests or waiting on hard copies to be mailed. Peter Willis,

Right now, the U.S. government is preparing to send a staggering 20,000

These are the same kinds of bombs that have leveled schools, hospitals,
and entire neighborhoods in Gaza, just as Israel doubles down on its
attacks on civilians in Lebanon, Iran, and across the region. This isn’t
security. This isn’t self-defense. This is senseless, unchecked warfare.

Every new weapons deal is a blank check for more devastation. And
Netanyahu’s government will only stop if we stop enabling them – which is
why Bernie filed a resolution to halt the sale and needs ALL of us to back
him RIGHT NOW.

this deadly weapons shipment. The vote could happen any day!

in Lebanon, targeting its first responders and medical centers and forcing
hospitals to evacuate. US and Israeli airstrikes just obliterated Sharif
University of Technology in Tehran – a world-renowned school known as the
“MIT of Iran.” Students and faculty lost their labs, their classrooms, and
their safety.

campaign that deliberately targets civilian life, culture, and the
prospects for peace. And once again the U.S. is enabling it, pushing for
escalations while dismissing the lives lost on all sides.

Bernie is leading the charge to halt this deal by forcing lawmakers to
vote on the bomb shipments. But for it to pass, he needs a massive
groundswell – a surge of public pressure from all of us.

Tomorrow is Election Day in Wisconsin, where voters will choose their state’s next supreme court justice.
In a moment, I’ll explain why this election is crucial for fair representation. But if you don’t need the refresher, [**please make a contribution to support our work to elect Democracy Defenders nationwide.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128942435/612799825/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_WIElectionLiftnote_email_20260407-NDRC-Tier1-WIElectionLiftnote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260407-NDRC-Tier1-WIElectionLiftnote_&utm_campaign=WIElectionLiftnote&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI1MzhiN2FhLTgxMzItZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=I7-b4wPt59_SeCLWdpVoqvdUuP6ffQULwuMsbCM0Omw=)

The MAGA-endorsed candidate is going out of her way to defend the ugly history of Republican map manipulation in the state. Yes, Peter, she’s on the record supporting “some of the most gerrymandered maps” and cosigning the anti-democracy tactics Republicans are using right now to try and rig the midterms so that they can maintain their grip on power.
The good news is, even a small donation from grassroots supporters like you can help elect Democracy Defenders like Judge Chris Taylor in Wisconsin.

name: Scott Brown
subject: The fight we’re in now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
I didn’t grow up with much, Peter.

I remember opening the fridge as a kid and seeing the blocks of government
cheese.

I remember being told, “Your mother doesn’t give us enough to feed you,” when
I asked for seconds.

I knew what it felt like to be hungry – and worse, to feel like a burden.

But I didn’t complain. I worked my way through college, law school, and served
nearly 40 years in the National Guard.I built a life through grit, faith, and
service.

That’s why I’m furious about what’s happening now.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/somali-welfare-fraud-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_welfarefraud_cs?&utm_term=SUPERLIST>
While hardworking Americans are struggling to make ends meet, Somali
immigrants in Minnesotahave been caught stealing billions in taxpayer money –
fraudulently siphoning off welfare benefits, housing aid, and food assistance.

President Trump is taking action to stop it – calling it one of the biggest
welfare-fraud waves in U.S. history. And he’s right. The system that once
helped families like mine survive is now being abused by criminals who mock our
laws and values.

I’m running for Senate because we need leaders who will STAND UP, not look
the other way.

I know the value of a dollar. And I would not be asking you to contribute
today if it didn’t make a difference in our country’s future.

This is the most important race in the entire country. Chip in $5, $25, or
even $100 today to give our campaign the resources we need to fight back – hard.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/somali-welfare-fraud-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_welfarefraud_cs?&utm_term=SUPERLIST>

But here’s the truth: my opponent, Chris Pappas, is raking in Soros-linked
cash and Hollywood donations to keep this seat blue. If we let that happen, we
lose the Senate – and everything conservatives like you and me have fought for.

Without Republican Majorities in Congress, investigations into the waste and
theft of taxpayers’ funds wouldn’t be happening.If you agree, this fraud must
END – chip in any amount now.
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/somali-welfare-fraud-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_welfarefraud_cs?&utm_term=SUPERLIST>
DONATE
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/somali-welfare-fraud-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_welfarefraud_cs?&utm_term=SUPERLIST>
The American Dream isn’t dead, but it’s under attack. Let’s take it back.

- Scott P. Brown
Candidate for U.S. Senate, NH

name: Americans for Responsible Innovation
subject: Lunch & Learn: Faith, Ethics, and AI | Join Us on Capitol Hill, April 22
body:
Faith leaders and AI policy converge on Capitol Hill. Join us April 22 at the Dirksen Senate Building.

| [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=9d865eedb3&e=a07d75591f)
---
| **April 22, 2026 · 12:00 PM ET · Dirksen Senate Building, Room G50** | [Register Now](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=37c8e88059&e=a07d75591f)
---|---
As artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes our world, it raises urgent questions not only about technology, but about humanity — our values, responsibilities, and purpose. This lunch-and-learn panel brings together a diverse group of faith leaders from various traditions to explore how spiritual and moral frameworks can help guide the development and use of AI. Together, they will discuss the ethical challenges and opportunities posed by AI, the role of faith communities in shaping public understanding, and how theological wisdom can speak to emerging technologies. **Join us for a rich conversation at the intersection of faith, ethics, and innovation.** A light lunch will be provided; please RSVP to ensure we can accommodate all attendees.
| [Save Your Spot](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=e0d2deb42b&e=a07d75591f)
---
| Confirmed Speakers | |
---

|
---
Brad Littlejohn American Compass
|
---
Meredith Gardner Mormon Women for Ethical Government
|
---
Moderator | | Ray Kim International Center for Religion & Diplomacy
---|---
|
---
What We'll Explore | → How do faith traditions approach the ethical questions raised by AI?
---
→ What role can faith communities play in shaping AI governance?
→ How should AI developers and policymakers engage with moral and spiritual values?
→ What does human dignity mean in an age of intelligent machines?
|

name: Scott P. Brown
subject: It’s not always easy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
Patriot,

It often comes as a surprise to people I meet on the campaign trail that I
didn’t grow up with aspirations of becoming an Ambassador or U.S. Senator
growing up.

I aspired to be a good husband, and a good dad. I aspired to have a happy
family life and live the American Dream.

I had a challenging upbringing. My mom was married and divorced 4 times, and
my dad was married and divorced 3 times. My dad was not always there to help
guide me and all my stepfathers told me that I would never amount to anything.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>
It’s fair to say they were not support systems. But I really wouldn't change a
thing. Those early struggles taught me grit, resilience, and the value of hard
work.

Nothing was ever handed to me.

I worked my way through college and law school, and at 19 I joined the Army
National Guard, where I served proudly for nearly 40 years before retiring as a
Colonel.
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>
In 2010, I took a leap of faith and ran for U.S. Senate. With grassroots
supporters like you and a lot of miles on my old GMC truck, we shocked the
political world with a historic upset. I was the guy that STOPPED the
Democrats’ supermajority in the Senate. In Washington, I refused to play
insider games—and that made me a target. Democrats poured millions into
defeating me, and eventually, they did.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>
But I never stopped serving. I became a grandfather, poured myself into my New
Hampshire community, and later represented America as U.S. Ambassador to New
Zealand and Samoa.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>

Now, I’m stepping back into the fight!
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-email-cs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=cs&utm_campaign=20260407_bio_cs?&utm_term=GFY2>

| | Dear Fellow American,

America's story is written not just in ink -- but in the stone, soil, and battlefields where freedom was born.

Yet today, too many of America's sacred places have been captured by the radical Left. Leftist radicals use them to indoctrinate unsuspecting citizens and tell a false version of American history.

That's why The Heritage Foundation created _**The Heritage Guide to Historic Sites**_ -- a free, digital resource featuring **45 historic locations** across the United States that tell the true story of America through the places where it happened.

Each site is carefully reviewed for historical accuracy, rated from **A to C** , so you can know which tours tell the truth -- and which distort it.

He added that "47 years of extortion, corruption, and death, will finally end" and urged "God Bless the Great People of Iran!"
* * *
# **Missing Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei unconscious and "unable to be involved in any decision-making," intelligence memo reveals**
Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, 56, **[is unconscious and"unable to be involved in any decision-making"](https://substack.com/redirect/851175a1-44f3-41ab-bf4c-12b7454f7290?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while undergoing medical treatment for a "severe" condition in Qom, roughly 87 miles south of Tehran, according to an intelligence memo obtained by the Times of London based on US and Israeli intelligence. Khamenei has not been seen since being severely injured during Feb. 28 US-Israeli strikes that killed his father Ali Khamenei and much of his family, with only written statements given as questionable proof of leadership.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/851175a1-44f3-41ab-bf4c-12b7454f7290?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Conflicting reports have emerged about Khamenei's injuries since the war's outbreak--some claiming only a fractured foot and minor injuries, others suggesting he's in a coma. Since being named his father's successor last month, statements supposedly from Khamenei have been broadcast via state media, including a March 12 message vowing "we will not refrain from avenging the blood of your martyrs" and an April 1 statement pledging to support "the resistance against the Zionist-American enemy."
* **The uncertainty:** Until now, Khamenei's absence has fueled speculation about his condition and Iran's actual leadership structure, with the memo confirming he is currently incapacitated and cannot participate in regime decision-making despite written statements attributed to him continuing to emerge through official channels.

* * *
# **Mamdani releases robust "Racial Equity Plan" sparking Trump DOJ review and backlash**
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani **[released his"Preliminary Citywide Racial Equity Plan"](https://substack.com/redirect/c9b67962-6730-41ad-a67d-926c6200a4d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Monday showing racial disparities in housing, education, and income, with the plan establishing "a new framework for how New York City measures affordability, understands inequity and plans for a more equitable future."
Mamdani said "Black and Latino New Yorkers--who have been pushed out of this city for decades--are bearing the brunt" and "we cannot tackle systemic racial inequity without confronting the affordability crisis head-on."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c9b67962-6730-41ad-a67d-926c6200a4d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The plan features more than 200 agency-level goals, over 800 proposed strategies, and roughly 600 performance indicators across seven domains including economy, housing, health, and community safety. DOJ Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon posted "sounds fishy/illegal" and "will review!" while Libs of TikTok called it "straight-up racism against White people." The city billed it as the "first time any NYC administration has required major city agencies to examine their work through a racial equity lens."
* **The spending:** The Office of Racial Equity will receive $5.6 million annually while the Commission on Racial Equity gets $4.6 million--a combined $10.2 million representing roughly a 42% jump from last year's $7.2 million. During his campaign, Mamdani proposed shifting "the tax burden from overtaxed homeowners in the outer boroughs to more expensive homes in richer and Whiter neighborhoods."

Our plan rests on three pillars.
**Primary Care for All** — The research is clear: universal access to primary care leads to better outcomes. So we’re making it a priority: Preventive care that keeps people out of hospitals and emergency rooms; whole-person care focused on physical, mental and behavioral health; and real support for our kids through “Hope,” our youth mental health initiative.
**Best Care, Best Price** — We must expand ways for Coloradans to afford and access care. That includes opening the state employee health plan to teachers and others, more affordable plans, and enhanced care delivery — in rural Colorado and beyond — including more virtual and at-home care, and reduced drug prices.
**A Health Consumer Pact** — Trump’s federal government is hell-bent on leaving Coloradans behind. I will build on my work as your Attorney General to curb surprise billing and medical debt, challenge increasing corporate ownership, lower drug costs, and bolster our public health infrastructure.
We will drive this work by:
* **Expanding** our health care workforce
* **Ensuring** our most vulnerable are enrolled in safety net public programs to keep them covered and costs to the system down
* **Investing** in rural health care
* **Innovating** with new ideas and technology to improve access and quality outcomes and protect consumer data

This plan wasn’t a one-person job. It came from conversations with individuals, families, and professionals from all over our state. **And I’m excited to talk it over with you more in the coming days and weeks, because to me, the right way to problem-solve is _together._**
**[Just like other issues that matter to Coloradans, I don’t let special interests or out-of-state billionaires set our health care agenda. That power belongs to YOU, and it’s why I’m committed to keeping this campaign grassroots. clean_body: My plan to take on this challenge. Folks, health care in Colorado is too costly, too inaccessible, and too difficult to navigate. Every Coloradan should have accessible, quality health care for the lowest cost. Today, I unveiled our “Healthy Colorado Plan,” which will focus on lowering costs and transforming Colorado’s “sick care” system into a true “health care” system. = | | = | = Our plan rests on three pillars. Primary Care for All — The research is clear: universal access to primary care leads to better outcomes. So we’re making it a priority: Preventive care that keeps people out of hospitals and emergency rooms; whole-person care focused on physical, mental and behavioral health; and real support for our kids through “Hope,” our youth mental health initiative. Best Care, Best Price — We must expand ways for Coloradans to afford and access care. That includes opening the state employee health plan to teachers and others, more affordable plans, and enhanced care delivery — in rural Colorado and beyond — including more virtual and at-home care, and reduced drug prices. A Health Consumer Pact — Trump’s federal government is hell-bent on leaving Coloradans behind. I will build on my work as your Attorney General to curb surprise billing and medical debt, challenge increasing corporate ownership, lower drug costs, and bolster our public health infrastructure. We will drive this work by: Expanding our health care workforce Ensuring our most vulnerable are enrolled in safety net public programs to keep them covered and costs to the system down Investing in rural health care Innovating with new ideas and technology to improve access and quality outcomes and protect consumer data This plan wasn’t a one-person job. It came from conversations with individuals, families, and professionals from all over our state. JoAnna Mendoza and Jonathan Nez.
#

Friend, it's Mark.
For all of us, taking back majorities in the House and Senate is incredibly important. It won’t be easy, though. The people running those races face a number of challenges. I know that all too well — my two campaigns for Senate were some of the most expensive in history.
It shouldn’t take millions and millions of dollars to run for Congress, but after Citizens United and the injection of unlimited donations from billionaires and corporate PACs, that’s the world we live in.
For my part, I’m going to do everything I can to level the playing field. So, today, I want to tell you about two candidates in Arizona that could determine which party controls the House next year.
JoAnna Mendoza and Jonathan Nez.
JoAnna is a former Marine Corps drill instructor, a single mom, and a critical voice for her community. She’s running in Arizona’s 6th Congressional District.
Jonathan is the former President of the Navajo Nation, the largest tribe in the country. He’s running in Arizona’s 2nd Congressional District.
Both are the exact kind of citizen leaders our country needs right now, and both have a really good chance of winning their races if they get the support they need.
We can make sure that happens, so I’m asking you to split a donation between their two campaigns.

I want to tell you what my bill does and why it matters to every taxpayer.

| | | | | [|

| | Peter ,

I have news, and I want you to hear it directly from me. This week, the United States House of Representatives passed my bill — the SMART Space Act. Let me tell you exactly what it does. The federal government owns and leases hundreds of millions of square feet of property across this country. Office buildings. Warehouses. Facilities in every state. And a massive portion of that space is sitting underutilized or completely vacant. Empty hallways. Empty offices. Empty buildings. But the bills keep coming. Maintenance. Utilities. Operations. Month after month, year after year. And you’re the one paying for it. I sit on the House Oversight Committee. I’ve seen this waste up close. I’ve reviewed the numbers. And I decided to do something about it instead of just talking about it. Here’s what my bill requires: ✅ A full audit of how federal properties are actually being used — conducted with private-sector real estate experts, not more government bureaucrats ✅ A comprehensive report delivered to Congress and the President within 120 days of enactment ✅ A concrete plan to reduce excess space and lower costs for taxpayers No more kicking the can down the road. No more hiding behind vague budget line items. Real accountability, on a real deadline. The House passed it. Now it heads to the Senate. Not backing down,

| | | | | | Peter,
With ballots dropping in under a month, our reelection campaign is entering a critical stretch. We’re grateful for the strong support we’ve continued to receive from leaders and community members across Los Angeles, from state leaders like State Senators Ben Allen and Henry Stern to local leaders like County Supervisor Lindsey Horvath. Now it’s time to turn that momentum into action.
At a moment when politics can feel particularly overwhelming, local government is one of the most direct places that everyday people can make an impact. **That’s why we need your help to spread the word and get out the vote.**
One of the best ways that you can help today is to [**sign up to volunteer.**](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=735154f61d&e=3cf484ad56) You can knock doors, make phone calls, send texts, or even host an event!
I’m feeling good about where we are, but we can’t do this without you. Join us, and spread the word. Together, we can continue our work of putting kids first.

subject: Barlow For Wyoming Newsletter
body:
OUT & ABOUT ACROSS WYOMING
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNMADDX5WAZPE8PXDXZ15QY5_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| OUT & ABOUT ACROSS WYOMING
---
| Hi friends, We hope you and your families had a blessed Easter weekend.
Last week, Kelly and I spent time traveling through communities across the state, working our way through Fremont, Park, Hot Springs, and Big Horn Counties. We were so encouraged by the strong turnout at events, and had great conversations, and connected with great folks along the way. Everywhere we went, people were engaged and paying attention. There’s a lot of pride in these communities and a real focus on making sure Wyoming continues to move in the right direction. We want to help. We were glad to see some much-needed moisture across parts of the state and appreciate the crews who worked hard to restore power in Sheridan and Johnson Counties. As this campaign continues to grow, so does the work that goes into it. From getting signs up to making sure we’re reaching people across Wyoming, every bit helps. If you’re in a position to contribute, we’d appreciate your support as we keep this effort moving forward. As this campaign continues to grow, so does the work that goes into it. From getting signs up to making sure we’re reaching people across Wyoming, every bit helps. If you’re in a position to contribute financially, we’d appreciate your support as we keep this effort moving forward. — Eric
---
|
---
| | [ SUPPORT ERIC! ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNMADDX5WAZPE8PXDXZ15QY5_1)
---
|
---
| | | IN THE NEWS Cody Enterprise [Barlow says he will use Wyoming’s ‘bully pulpit’ to defend public lands, state interests](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNMADDX5WAZPE8PXDXZ15QY5_2) photo by Jana Cardew "Barlow said that as the state’s chief executive he would use, “Wyoming’s people and our industries to exert our sovereignty and use Wyoming’s bully pulpit to guarantee we have a place in those conversations. “I will be at those tables and (through me) the people will have a voice.”
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | SHARE THE SIGNS YOU SEE!
The Barlow for Governor signs are starting to appear across the Wyoming landscape, with strong backing for the Wyoming weather!

Be sure to send us the signs you see as they grow in number! Send to our FB Messenger or to: communications@barlowforwyo.com
---
| | |
---
| | [ HELP WITH SIGN COSTS! ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNMADDX5WAZPE8PXDXZ15QY5_3)
---
| |
---
| -Engagement with Cody Youth for Justice (virtual), Tuesday, Apr 7 · 11–11:45 AM - Coffee with Eric, Upton, Friday Apr 10, 8-9 AM Remy's Diner, 1019 US-16, Upton, WY 82730, USA -Coffee with Eric in Newcastle, Friday, Apr 10 · 10–11 AM Isabella's, 12 S Sumner Ave, Newcastle, WY
-Sundance Meet & Greet, Friday, Apr 10 · 2–3 PM
Longhorn Saloon & Grill, 214 E Main St, Sundance, WY \- Gillette College Casino Night, Friday, April 10, 5-9 PM -Douglas Boys & Girls Club Dinner, Saturday, Apr 11 · 5–8 PM -Glendo Community Visit, Tuesday, Apr 14 · 8–9:15 AM
118 Paige Ave, Glendo, WY -Guernsey VFW Visit, Tuesday, Apr 14 · 10–11:15 AM
42 S Idaho Ave, Guernsey, WY -Guernsey Senior Center Visit, Tuesday, Apr 14 · 11:30 AM–12:30 PM
100 S Wyoming Ave, Guernsey, WY -Lusk Meet & Greet and Fundraiser, Tuesday, Apr 14 · 5:30–7:30 PM
34 WY-273, Lusk, WY
---
|
---
| **On The Trail**
---
| | | PARK COUNTY
From dinner with the Park County GOP to breakfast in Cody, a luncheon and tour at Northwest College, a meet & greet and the Young Professionals event in Lovell—there has been wonderful turnout across the board. Grateful for the conversations, the support, and everyone who helped make these events possible. Thank you for showing up.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | BIG HORN COUNTY
A great day in Greybull with stops at Dry Bones Coffee and Bob’s Diner. Thank you to everyone who showed up. We were treated to a wonderful tour at the Greybull Museum of Flight and Aerial Firefighting, hosted by Bobby Hawkins.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | Along the way, we made a stop to visit the Queen Bee Gardens' Greybull location for some gourmet honey candy, where we said hello to Miss Mary, the Queen Bee clerk! If you haven't tried their candy, you should! They have stores in Cody, Greybull, Lovell, and Powell as well as in Granby, CO.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | FREMONT & HOT SPRINGS COUNTIES Kelly and I have been blessed with some great (and big) crowds! Thank you to everyone in Lander who joined us for the meet and greet and outdoors-focused events! We also enjoyed dancing at the Riverton Senior Center! While in the area, we were able to take a tour of the Hot Springs School District and had lunch in Shoshoni at the Senior Center. We appreciate all of the important Wyoming conversations!
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | CAMPBELL COUNTY We are so appreciative to those who open up their hearts (and often, their homes) to host meet-and-greets or fundraisers along our path. This support makes a big difference in getting out our message. We attended a wonderful fundraiser in Gillette, hosted by our dear friends Jeff and Tracy Wasserburger and David and Julie Fall.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| **Get In The Saddle**
---
| | |
---
| | | | Wyoming’s strength has always come from neighbors pitching in. Join the Barlow For Wyoming team of volunteers who are helping share his message across our state. **🤠 Ride with us — sign up to volunteer!**

As moms our influence on the next generation can't be overstated. You have the power to protect your kids from being fooled by these exclusions and lies. # See you Saturday!
---
| | Hey everyone, I wanted to let you know about a great event we will be doing with the Morgan County Young Republicans and Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita Saturday!
---
|
---
| |
I hope you can make this great event we will be doing in Martinsville this Saturday at the Groggy Goat. We expect great turnout, great opportunities to meet with your elected officials, and a fun time for everyone who comes! If you want a yard sign as well, we would be happy to bring one for you if you can make it! Hope to see you soon!

---
|
---
|
---

| Peter, I only have one thing to say: **THANK YOU!**

Thanks to our incredible team of grassroots supporters, we blew our End of Quarter fundraising goal out of the water.

In Q1, we had **4,997 new supporters** join our movement, with an **average donation of just $21.95.** I’ve said it before, and I’ll keep saying it: This is a people-powered campaign, and it always will be.

As the youngest member of Congress, I know firsthand that it’s harder to stretch a dollar these days – especially while also paying rent, trying to afford groceries, and keeping up while your utility companies raise your bills.

The fact that folks are willing to spare a few bucks here and there to power our campaign means the world to me.

**But Peter, we can’t slow down now, because the right wing are about to ramp up their attacks on our movement.**

Florida Republicans are plotting to redraw the Congressional maps and cheat their way into taking us down. They’re trying to rig votes; we’re going to earn them.

body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter,
This is Dylan with Team Kelly – I hope you’re well! I’m reaching out to let you know that applications for our paid summer internship program are open! If you or someone you know may be interested in interning with Team Kelly, please take a minute to read this email!
For all of her campaigns, Kelly has recruited a team of paid interns to organize, knock doors, build relationships in communities, and gain valuable hands-on experience about how to run a successful campaign. This internship is designed not just to support the campaign’s goals, but to give interns real life tangible and transferable skills into whatever role is next for them. Many of our former interns are out in the world doing amazing things – managing campaigns, working in policy, and some have even run for office themselves!
Below I’ve included the details for applying:
* View the Job Description [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nk6Dtc_y9WP4wNcxS-N1cZ82t0zoHcsm/view?usp=sharing]
* How to Apply : Interested applicants should email their resume and a short cover letter addressing the question: What do you hope to gain from this internship? to Dylan Nilsson at dylan@kellyforcongress.org [dylan@kellyforcongress.org] with the subject line “Application: Morrison for Congress Intern.”
* Applications close on April 30th
Thank you Peter for your continued support! If you have any questions, please feel free to respond to this email.
Best,
Dylan Nilsson

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

And year after year, most people follow the same path: Take the RMD in cash and move on. Not because it's the best choice. But because no one ever tells them there's another way. Financial institutions make it easy to withdraw cash. Too easy. But simple isn't always strategic. Taking your RMD in cash may: Increase taxable income Force you to sell assets at moments that may notalign with your plan Reduce the overall portion of your wealth that remains invested And yet... Few realize that RMDs can also be taken "in-kind." Meaning: instead of withdrawing cash, you can receive certain assets directly without liquidating them first. No, it doesn't eliminate taxes. But for many savers, it may help them: Preserve their long-term allocation Avoid being forced to sell during volatile markets Strengthen diversification, depending on their strategy It's fully IRS-allowed... but rarely mentioned in traditional planning conversations. Before You Take Your Next RMD, Ask Yourself: Do I know most IRS-approved ways to satisfy my distribution? Am I selling assets when I don't want to - or at prices I don't like? Could an in-kind distribution align better with my long-term goals and risk tolerance? For something you're required by law to take each year, understanding your options isn't optional - it's essential. | | | | | | Peter,

**We are excited to announce that Brent Tweed has joined Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire as our new State Director!

** Brent brings decades of proven grassroots activism and a deep commitment to constitutional principles. His journey in the liberty movement began with the Ron Paul 2008 campaign, where he volunteered at the Concord office and helped build support across New England.

He later chaired the 2012 Maine Republican State Convention as part of the effort to elect Ron Paul delegates to the national convention, and he served as the Maine delegation chair.

Brent also served as Maine Campaign for Liberty State Coordinator, where he worked closely with Senator Eric Brakey to help pass constitutional carry and hosted leadership trainings across the state.

**Since moving to New Hampshire in 2016, Brent has remained deeply engaged in local politics to advance liberty.**

He has attended town committee meetings, served on his local budget committee, and was recently elected as a Republican delegate to the New Hampshire State Convention.

He also co-produced the Free State Project’s NH Liberty Forum in both 2025 and 2026.
---
[|
---](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=15f9d1611b&e=8c8e704ee6)
| [JOIN THE FIGHT TO MAKE NEW HAMPSHIRE A LIBERTY STATE >>>](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=aa73c1684e&e=8c8e704ee6)
---
| | **In his new role as State Director, Brent will help expand our operations, strengthen our grassroots network, hold more lawmakers accountable to The Pledge, and advance policies that protect parental rights, self-defense, educational freedom, and state sovereignty.

** His experience building effective campaigns and turning principles into legislative wins will be instrumental as we work to make New Hampshire a true Liberty State.

With a background as a nuclear engineer (_including work at Seabrook Station and Portsmouth Naval Shipyard_), Brent combines technical expertise with a passionate dedication to limited government and individual liberty.

Please join us in welcoming Brent to the team. We are confident his leadership will take Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire to the next level in our fight to keep New Hampshire the _**Live Free or Die**_ state.

You can contact Brent at [Brent@CitizensAllianceNH.org](mailto:brent@citizensalliancenh.org) if you have any questions or ideas on how to make New Hampshire a Liberty State!

For New Hampshire,

The Shield of Rights Journey Starts Tomorrow
