| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

### **Donald Trump And His Predator Pals Would Burn the World to Rule the Ashes**
_**by Cliff Schecter**_
Donald Trump is an agent of chaos. His billionaire pals, too, are filled with sadistic pleasure at the mere thought of hurting others, which you can see in their behavior. Take a "man" like Elon Musk--who was three years behind me at Penn. Is it possible he cut SNAP so kids starve and eliminated USAID so kids die, because deep down he knows he's garbage? That he leveraged mommy and daddy's Apartheid emeralds into PayPal, whose profits he used to buy someone else's idea and create Tesla?
Which then allowed him to buy an adult man's jaw line and some extra hair?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/48a84a2a-1c91-4a99-96ad-b047440e2935?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=193475684&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkzNDc1Njg0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzU1OTkwNDYsImV4cCI6MTc3ODE5MTA0NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.av6Xaabdc-doIK0jh14RgAOsYkNzDtn_R0vOwBivpkc)
* * *
Definitely possible, folks.
In arguably the best movie of its genre, _The Dark Knight_(2008), Alfred Pennyworth tells Bruce Wayne a story about a bandit he encountered in Burma. This thief would steal their rubies and then just toss them, because, as has been said of Trump, "the cruelty was the point." Or as Pennyworth (played brilliantly by Michael Kane) put it, "some men just want to watch the world burn."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/48a84a2a-1c91-4a99-96ad-b047440e2935?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump is a hybrid--he wants wealth and power, and some fire. Buried beneath that discolored, demonstrably un-svelte, colic exterior is pure rage for how daddy never loved him. If his choice is letting others be happy while he whines, fails and blubbers, or ruining it for everyone, without a second thought (or a first in his case) _he 'll blow it all up_ _to ensure we 're all just as miserable as he is _while staring acrimoniously into his cracked, golden mirror each morning.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/48a84a2a-1c91-4a99-96ad-b047440e2935?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Right now, Iran is embarrassing him. He's losing the war. And the theocratic mullahs are rubbing it in because they understand psychological warfare better than most Democrats. Exhibit A: this was posted by Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf just the other day:
> After defeating Iran 37 times in a row, this brilliant no-strategy war they started has now been downgraded from 'regime change' to 'Hey! Can anyone find our pilots? Please?' Wow. What incredible progress. Absolute geniuses.
So Trump predictably, toddler-like as always, overreacted. And now we're potentially--though Trump will likely chicken out, Thank God--on the brink of nuclear war.
The most maddening part is as as this demented dingus drags the world to the lip of nuclear conflict, he could be stopped at any moment by a handful of Republicans. As Trump treats human civilization with the care of The Trump Taj Mahal--something to loot, bankrupt, and leave smoldering--there is only one morally coherent response: **remove him from office**. Full stop.
It would take two-to-three House members. You have so-called reasonable ones who've taken multiple oaths to this country in retiring Rep. and former Brigadier General, Don Bacon, and former FBI agent, Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick. But, nope, no courage to be found. Bacon's only good at tweeting shit he does nothing about:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/48a84a2a-1c91-4a99-96ad-b047440e2935?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

* * *

| **To:** Friends and Supporters
**From:** John Block, Campaign Manager
**Date:** April 07, 2026
**Re:** Less Than 3 Months

We are exactly 11 weeks from the June 23rd primary so I wanted to provide an update on our momentum and the state of the race as we head into this final stretch as this campaign extends beyond insiders and into the increased awareness of the broader electorate.

**1 - Our polling confirms what other recently released polling shows: the race is wide open, with a majority of voters still undecided.** Here are some other key take-aways:
* **Andrew has the best opportunity to introduce himself to voters and grow his support.** While Jawando and Glass are slightly better known, their initial higher name IDs are not translating into higher vote share. Andrew starts this final stage of the campaign in strong shape against two better known opponents, and has the most room to define himself with voters.
* **Andrew’s track record and vision focused on affordability is most compelling to likely voters.** We see Andrew’s message resonating very powerfully with the broadest segments of the Democratic Primary electorate, with 51% finding his message very appealing, Friedson's profile is more appealing than either Jawando's and Glass's, and he gains the most after voters hear balanced, positive introductions of all candidates.
* **The contrast between the top three candidates on taxes and affordability is powerful.** Both Glass and Jawando have significant vulnerabilities from their positions on taxes. It is an important framework to distinguish Andrew and set him apart from the field. Communicating this contrast message between Andrew and his two main opponents is essential to making the choice clear for voters in this close race.
* **The more information voters have about the race, the better Andrew does.** After voters hear more information about Andrew and the upcoming election, he opens up a significant advantage, leading the field, opening up a commanding 15% lead on the closest competitor.

**2 - The central contrast of this race has become even more stark.** As you may have seen, current County Executive Marc Elrich proposed a massive property tax and income tax hike in his most recent budget. Andrew has stood forcefully against these burdens in the past and once again took a leadership role in opposing them now. You can read his full statement on the proposed increases here: [_**Councilmember Andrew Friedson’s Statement on Proposed FY27 Tax Increases**_**.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128999494/612951203/1230135128?Item_ID=48394&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjVhYWJlYS1jODMyLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_PTBnA2wbk9-sL9psM3Hjn3-MmpHGNcrLsQTAKkcItQ=&emci=9c1bf88e-a432-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=1b5aabea-c832-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=21244937)

**3 - We have officially launched our campaign’s first digital ad.[_You can watch it here_.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128999495/612951204/-260259990?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-04-07_1&amount=25&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjVhYWJlYS1jODMyLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_PTBnA2wbk9-sL9psM3Hjn3-MmpHGNcrLsQTAKkcItQ=)** As you saw above, it is critical for voters to know exactly where Andrew stands on affordability. As we enter the final stage of the campaign, we are the first to start communicating with voters broadly about a key issue.

**Conclusion:** Andrew has put himself in a strong position to win by earning the support of a wide range of early supporters. He has now been endorsed by the career and volunteer firefighters, retired public school teachers, the majority of the State Senate delegation, David Blair and Hans Riemer (who represented 60% of the vote in the 2022 Executive race), and countless local, municipal, and community leaders. **We know Andrew has a clear path to victory if we can communicate directly with voters.** Polling demonstrates the more voters learn about Andrew, the more his support grows - making our ability to fund a grassroots organizing effort (with mailers and ads) mission critical. We have set a goal to raise $50,000 to ensure we stay on the air and continue to define this race on our terms.

She’s not new to this work | |

|
---
Hi friends!

It’s Kalliana, Sue’s campaign manager. I wanted to reach out with an update that’s really important to all of us here at Team AnderBois.

Earth Day is coming up, and we can’t think of a better way to celebrate than by sharing a few pieces that show exactly who Sue is and why she’s the right person to bring real climate & environmental leadership to the Lieutenant Governor’s office.

Sue is not new to this work. Long before she was running for statewide office. Long before the City Council. She has been one of Rhode Island’s most dedicated climate and food policy advocates for a long time — and people have noticed.

So in the spirit of Earth Month, here’s a little media roundup of some of Sue’s top climate hits 👇

| **Rhode Island PBS — Earth Week Feature** A few years back (see, I told you she’s not new to this!), Rhode Island PBS spotlighted Sue as part of their Earth Week programming, and it’s honestly one of my favorite things to share with people who are just getting to know Sue and what she stands for.

The segment captures how Sue’s been thinking about the intersection of food, energy, and climate long before it was fashionable. As RI’s first-ever governor-appointed Director of Food Strategy (she was the first in the entire country, by the way 🤯), she laid out a real, actionable vision for how our food and energy systems could strengthen communities and protect our future. **[Watch this awesome doc >>](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMacp2UBOxuou_KlgSFUiMlpSwv6oyvkcYnh6V0N0PG4J8qp0oQ4ctHTn7HQIv8TC5AIvrrtVonwU1Z-FU7eRd94hFXCDCIEXh-oN5ox6kUWKdjgZ1o0CChejO5eB-eRKVhyfFEch8Pn28gL-9_DzEpBq9x1Om_imhvNeUpWTKlXMHKGrywy9ehVKGFTHrzKIGE5KfDIeTQhNMLyQ0jmVehuj99lCzOuVUq5MLIamSfVD3BvGpXsXNRtgR6fyXPIPO4fUN6fA5gMjLFg0vQ9olM0ErU1QVkC6cTrq-8Ta3rOyWjKiOIHT3c56whLuraNt4L07vGUMHiesvPYBGWbWR-0bPsDtHXvf23kZ4MOWJNeDjdh1p7eGHxUsbIADws2W_w/4pl/bQyghvhlQyWC42tzPnY6YA/h0/h001.GXOid0wblcdTxcD7rtxFXbCJAdiA64S9zQY4fAvGSPI)** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMacp2UBOxuou_KlgSFUiMlpSwv6oyvkcYnh6V0N0PG4J8qp0oQ4ctHTn7HQIv8TC5AIvrrtVonwU1Z-FU7eRd94hFXCDCIEXh-oN5ox6kUWKdjgZ1o0CChejO5eB-eRKVt0iS0jdv2XhYi4XaQpIO0a66VJb3FetPOjoYUn1O2u4DJ4wkYnI1f_s3c73ecLwwk-L4sMq19PChirI_6c-vnx_QUvBtN_ZS8-yeOKePBmnlsbbCi0_s9iMcz9GXluAdsKtEs9-MPC1jaMSdW9fpmnW46b66QWJFCRRF31tpTWIWFDb7UpasWVhzh66D_gc8209pVgB2XAjMzXPVOHoBLfoikd1kpxQetzoyRl4N19iuuLMZyezBLChkBLqBZ4HRw/4pl/bQyghvhlQyWC42tzPnY6YA/h1/h001.-izu-vdkre11lyvgSXmcr4EMU4uQ4pf35yJJAuy7_Gw) | _"Her passionate advocacy guides policy and public awareness, providing a clear vision for food and energy for Rhode Island."_ — Rhode Island PBS

* * *
**Steve Ahlquist (Substack) — Interview: Why Sue Is Running**
Journalist Steve Ahlquist sat down with Sue for an in-depth conversation about why she’s making this run for higher office, and how she plans to use the Lt. Governor’s seat to move the needle on climate and energy in Rhode Island.

One thing that stuck with me from this interview: Sue said her whole approach to public service can be summed up in seven words that she has tattooed on her arm. It’s pretty great. **[I’ll let her say it >>](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vta2oZ0FuYE2syqGlbaYEkM5_JyT8bcAI2tCcOLGGODDUGxyKFQ7Y1Ck5x8RPFV2S6pwO0gdq_iJoleb9k46Axu9_-elV7UfNP61WyZa4dT30u-M1Xu6uZJXz_pGw9zesVpxRF4GeaAppJKx_b95tSMJIw-W6e46qJcntUWDKBe1M6P_imPKNQXAKqdbwKqzvirfpAlQFVEWcnPb0D-KLFB_Es-qDY7YLtTCEzYSwJFdR19BHndRkmg8cYvUzbWOwrbGbXyTWffvxDc5mFHA2LW1cHNWlcm59QRgBFh3L4IIH8rb47qoGq9XyZ065y74yx1Z3FZc0yxF4jP8cMU6H5qPmsj5a5TQmKVg4hjAT4gHFeEP4HgaOg2MR1GxNPyIyJteKGMqJ2VjxNFvxkb3WvbI/4pl/bQyghvhlQyWC42tzPnY6YA/h3/h001.htfiA2CDkpcIoSNmJb3oL-JR2nfyuA_V6PivHByZdJQ)**
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vta2oZ0FuYE2syqGlbaYEkM5_JyT8bcAI2tCcOLGGODDUGxyKFQ7Y1Ck5x8RPFV2S6pwO0gdq_iJoleb9k46Axu9_-elV7UfNP61WyZa4dT30u-M1Xu6uZJXz_pGw9zesVuLF6Oxd56RmLPUQbwpr-KJTjcpfr7kJP9Umhm7wu4kFb3es_29_oYnvnlAv9R663nS6GSFMviIUegenZPschgd47vy27uWH9AqQOHDgXG4K_sR8ZRiDqp1fZqanqBcEn98f88njIxqeluVplbTJIuJ4iPLkdNnt5e0C0Bjhwl8ACDGEWXaaftvJpNjGYhaJuOizqdOXgv46PsBaiJJcUpan4oJLCFCfG7LJzii3_urUj3RqwL8u2QOr7QLHn1LWvVG0AEK38dPFinDM6oSDYzU/4pl/bQyghvhlQyWC42tzPnY6YA/h4/h001.dyE6kFcoq7taJwMjpZD2CyiguQ6F_yPuPMbW-SWq2q0)
_"What are you going to do about it?"_ — Sue AnderBois
(and yes, it’s literally tattooed on her arm)

Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand?
The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill.
But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction.
So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026.
That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT!
That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are...
- Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024- Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year- Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course- Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did- Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris
They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth.
It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too.
That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer.
And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.
I say they're full of it (as usual).
I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. The folks who remember when the Democrats impeached our President, kicked him off the ballot, and indicted him in court WILL step up when we need them the most.
I'm hoping you fit that bill.

Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand? The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill. But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction. So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026. That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT! That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are... - Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024- Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year- Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course- Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did- Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth. It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too. That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer. And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels. The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot. I say they're full of it (as usual). I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. The folks who remember when the Democrats impeached our President, kicked him off the ballot, and indicted him in court WILL step up when we need them the most. I'm hoping you fit that bill. We set a goal of raising one million bucks this month from every zip code in America. That's how we can beat the Democrats at their own game, go on offense in every key race on the map, and ensure President Trump has a Conservative House and a Conservative Senate to Make America Great Again. Hey friend, At some point, we stopped being shocked by the things this president says and does, and that should scare all of us. The President of the United States has spent the last few days posting erratic, unhinged threats on social media (even by Trump's standards) while American troops are deployed in a war he started. This isn't tough talk, and it isn't strategy. It's a man who is not fit to hold the power he has. Our allies see it. Our enemies see it. The only people pretending not to see it are the officials in this administration and the members of Congress who are too afraid to do anything about it. Cabinet secretaries, Pentagon leadership, military commanders, and anyone going along with illegal orders need to understand something: **that is not a defense. The rule of law doesn't disappear because your boss told you to ignore it.** I served four tours under commanders I trusted with my life. The idea that our troops are now deployed at the direction of someone this unstable is something I take personally. Congress needs to come back into session immediately, assert its Constitutional authority, and begin impeachment proceedings. We have the tools to stop this. Because we know that’s what really matters to you, and we don’t blame you. So here’s the truth: **The DNC is working hard _every day_ to elect Democrats.** Not all of it makes the news or goes viral, but you should know that we’re making unprecedented investments in registering Democrats to vote and in all of our state parties. We’re working to reach voters who sat out previous elections with a new, listening-first outreach program. And we’re fighting in court to protect voting rights and fair elections. ####

|
* Women of Excellence honored during Women’s History Month
* Without stable funding, severe cuts coming to Caltrain
* Interpretive Pavilion at San Bruno Mountain Park taking shape

---
| | |
---
|
# “At the very moment local governments are losing tens of millions in state funding, they’re now being asked to absorb another $20 million hit.”
# **\- Supervisor David Canepa**
---
| | | | **2026 April e-**newsletter
**Interpretive Pavilion at San Bruno Mountain Park taking shape** Dear Friends,

San Mateo County Parks is getting closer to opening a new Interpretive Pavilion and picnic area at San Bruno Mountain Park in late spring and you can really start to see it come together. The new pavilion and restroom facility will sit right in the day-use area, creating a central hub for visitors to gather, learn and connect with the natural environment. We’ve also added new picnic tables in the open space nearby, giving families, students, and community groups a comfortable place to sit, eat and take in the views. These $2 million in improvements are designed to make the park more welcoming, accessible and educational for everyone who visits. This project is about more than upgrades, it’s about creating a space where people can learn about our local ecosystems, enjoy the outdoors and build community right here in San Mateo County. I am looking forward to seeing this space come to life soon and cannot wait to welcome the community to enjoy this new enhanced outdoor recreational space. **Without stable funding, severe cuts coming to Caltrain** Caltrain is facing serious potential service cuts without a new, stable funding source and the impacts would be felt across San Mateo County. Despite strong ridership growth and high customer satisfaction, Caltrain could be forced to eliminate weekend service, reduce trains to once an hour, close stations, and end service early. That would mean more traffic, more pollution, and fewer transportation options for working families. Caltrain is essential to our economy and quality of life. It keeps people moving, supports local businesses, and reduces congestion on Highway 101. We need to work together regionally to secure long-term funding and protect this vital service for the residents and communities who depend on it every day. What makes this especially concerning is that Caltrain is actually succeeding. Ridership is up significantly, and the new electrified system is delivering faster, cleaner, and more reliable service. Cutting service now would reverse that progress and undermine the very investments we’ve made to modernize transit on the Peninsula. There is a path forward. A regional funding measure could stabilize Caltrain’s finances and ensure continued service, but it will require public support. This is a critical moment to invest in a system that is working and to protect a service that is vital to our environment, our economy, and our future. **Women of Excellence honored during Women’s History Month** I want to commend the Daly City Women’s Commission for honoring 12 Women of Excellence during Women’s History Month at a special event at City Hall March 19. Special thanks to my wife Ana Valenzuela for standing in my place to present commendations to the honorees and a special proclamation to the Women’s Commission. The Women’s Commission serves as an advisory body to the City Council with the mission to improve the quality of life for women of all ages in Daly City by identifying women’s needs, making policy and program recommendations to the City Council and educating the community on matters concerning women. The Women of Excellence honorees this year are Marie Villarosa, Patricia deVera and Shirley Chan. The Youth Women of Excellence are Jesslelynn Tran, Jasmine Castro, Estephanie Sente Guardia, Amnah Qayed, Azna Kyria Madu and Ayanna Rae Hernandez. The Kapwa Kultural Center and its founders Stephanie Balon and Chrisi Morales-Kumasawa, pictured above with Ana Valenzuela (photo courtesy of Patrick M. Gee), were honored as the Woman Community-Based Organization and finally Francine Kendrea Lucero was honored as the Commission’s Woman Warrior. Congratulations to all the winners!

**Landmark affordable housing project clears another hurdle** The landmark 72-unit affordable housing project on Eastmoor Avenue in Daly City cleared another hurdle in March as the Board of Supervisors provided notice of a Surplus Land Act exemption to the California Department of Housing and Community Development which paves the way for the project to move forward. In November, the County officially purchased the property at 493 Eastmoor Ave. for $4.4 million, unlocking the path to building 72 units of 100% affordable housing for households earning 20%–50% of the area median income. These homes won’t just serve today’s families; they’ll remain affordable for nearly a century, creating stability for generations. Our county should be extraordinarily proud of identifying and investing in this transit-rich, community-centered project. This is exactly the kind of bold action that prevents displacement, keeps families housed, and stops homelessness before it starts. By purchasing the property, we’re enabling the developer to secure the tax credits and financing necessary to bring this project to life. And the best part? No new funds were required. The $4.4 million was already allocated as part of our commitment to affordable housing. Now, with county ownership and a long-term lease in place, 55 years with an option for 44 more, we are ensuring long-term affordability and long-term stability. In friendship,
**DAVID J. CANEPA**
San Mateo County Board of Supervisors

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
This morning, I put out a statement through my office on the President of the United States’ unhinged post today stating that “a whole civilization will die tonight,” and I want you to know what I am thinking and what I am doing.
As I said this morning, over the past several days, the President of the United States has posted statements that are unhinged and untethered to reality. Over the past few years, we have gotten used to these rambling, incoherent posts on his personal, for-profit social media platform, and we have worried about their content as well as the conduct of United States policy—domestic and foreign—through this medium. For years, people have tried to rationalize them, minimize them, discount them, and normalize them. Today one thing is clear: We cannot ignore them.
The President’s statements are not only unhinged, they are dangerous—an escalation not only in rhetoric but in real-world consequences. body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Patriot!
| Patriot,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.

All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._

Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.

body:
I firmly believe “conversion therapy” has no place in Kentucky and in our country as a whole.
Peter, _I want to be very clear with you about where I stand on the Supreme Court’s ruling allowing conversion therapy in our country._

My faith teaches me something simple but powerful: Every child is a child of God. And because of that, I believe that anything that endangers or harms a child is wrong.

It opens the door to practices that we know can leave lasting scars on children who are already vulnerable. These are not "treatments." They are unfounded, discredited tactics that put young people in harm's way simply for being who they are.

_Simply put, conversion therapy is torture._

[**If you agree and think that it's time to leave the barbaric practice of conversion therapy in the past where it belongs, add your name to my petition today. >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129002397/612960021/-1339679461?ms=em26_260407_conthe_adv_gq_act___AB_ettx&refcode=em26_260407_conthe_adv_gq_act___AB_ettx&source=em26_260407_conthe_adv_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260407_conthe_adv_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=vASZ1vZbu2f5XgTSMsuJYuDVMMifvMqOGCPEPOTr81mdpiBJowcper6V1uHcvPl++tmj1Sf77v9ftUL2QqIYa42/K11A+sXRuf+wc6CfUNcnnHyB9mubylp+bt+TbzDnk8fHYXu/ANhUVJ8b25Ixixw9uPUfQSPh15mdqEw6Rp4H52nxFKgnlNkXFI4FbayW&refcode2=fcc47769-d332-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmNjNDc3NjktZDMzMi1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xJNeojY6P5m-TzV6lIisMzodIQGWsSQEvShVcVk6eOM=&emci=a81b5562-9532-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=fcc47769-d332-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=17458827)

Peter, as Governor, every time anti-LGBTQ+ legislation has come to my desk, I have vetoed it. And when the legislature declined to ban conversion therapy, I signed an executive order to ban it. Unfortunately, the legislature overrode the veto, but I showed the country and the Commonwealth where I stand. I did it because I listened to survivors who endured unimaginable trauma in their lives from these practices, and I trusted the doctors and mental health experts who have been clear for years that “conversion therapy” is a dangerous and harmful practice. And I didn't stop there.

I've always stood up against efforts to target and harm LGBTQ+ youth, vetoing bills that would have restricted their rights, speaking out against bullying and discrimination, and showing up to say clearly that they belong. I am the first governor of Kentucky to attend a Pride rally, and I'm proud to recognize Pride Month as a time of celebration in our state. I will always stand alongside advocates and families when they need me and use every tool available to me to protect kids in a state where that hasn't always been easy.

No child should be made to feel broken or be told they need to be "fixed." No child should suffer because of their identity, their beliefs, or who they love. We are talking about kids who deserve safety, dignity, and the freedom to grow into who they are without fear. In Kentucky, we value compassion, and I chose to stand up for those kids and to say clearly: **You belong, you are loved, and your government will not allow harm to come to you under the guise of care.**

clean_body: I firmly believe “conversion therapy” has no place in Kentucky and in our country as a whole. Peter, I want to be very clear with you about where I stand on the Supreme Court’s ruling allowing conversion therapy in our country. My faith teaches me something simple but powerful: Every child is a child of God. And because of that, I believe that anything that endangers or harms a child is wrong. It opens the door to practices that we know can leave lasting scars on children who are already vulnerable. These are not "treatments." They are unfounded, discredited tactics that put young people in harm's way simply for being who they are. Simply put, conversion therapy is torture. Peter, as Governor, every time anti-LGBTQ+ legislation has come to my desk, I have vetoed it. And when the legislature declined to ban conversion therapy, I signed an executive order to ban it. Unfortunately, the legislature overrode the veto, but I showed the country and the Commonwealth where I stand. I did it because I listened to survivors who endured unimaginable trauma in their lives from these practices, and I trusted the doctors and mental health experts who have been clear for years that “conversion therapy” is a dangerous and harmful practice. And I didn't stop there. I've always stood up against efforts to target and harm LGBTQ+ youth, vetoing bills that would have restricted their rights, speaking out against bullying and discrimination, and showing up to say clearly that they belong. I am the first governor of Kentucky to attend a Pride rally, and I'm proud to recognize Pride Month as a time of celebration in our state. I will always stand alongside advocates and families when they need me and use every tool available to me to protect kids in a state where that hasn't always been easy. No child should be made to feel broken or be told they need to be "fixed." No child should suffer because of their identity, their beliefs, or who they love. We are talking about kids who deserve safety, dignity, and the freedom to grow into who they are without fear. In Kentucky, we value compassion, and I chose to stand up for those kids and to say clearly: You belong, you are loved, and your government will not allow harm to come to you under the guise of care. In solidarity, Andy | | Kentucky Gov. A few years ago, I looked around and asked myself:

_Why are so many young women exhausted, anxious, and numb?_

Why do they feel betrayed by their bodies?

Why are they medicated into submission by 19... and afraid to admit they want marriage and motherhood?

**And how -- HOW -- did the Left convince them this was empowerment? **

The truth is, they didn't sell them freedom...

_They sold them bondage with a designer label. _

"Girlboss" feminism.

They told them the cure for their confusion was more pills... more dependency... more government... more Leftism.

That the antidote... _was more poison. _

This isn't accidental.

The Left built a system that breaks women -- and then sells them more brokenness to "fix" it.

Exploitation dressed up as "liberation."

But I don't believe women are broken... _or hopelessly lost to the Left... _

I just believe they've been lied to.

**And that 's why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit 2026 (WLS) matters now more than ever. **

**Because it 's more than a conference... It's a mass detox for America's young women: **

✅ Detox from the Left's propaganda.
✅ Detox from big food & big pharma lies.
✅ Detox from moral & cultural confusion.
✅ Detox from emotional numbness -- the kind I know personally, because I lived it.

I was on SSRIs (antidepressants).

I was sold the same pills, the same promises, the same "girlboss" trap.

And I got out.

I weaned off the meds. I reset my health. I embraced my femininity.

And I want other young women to know they can, too.

Because this isn't just about health...

It's about reclaiming your mind, your home, your faith. And your country.

**And that 's what this year's Women's Leadership Summit is all about -- reclaiming America's daughters from the lies the Left sold them.**

From June 5-7 in San Antonio, thousands of women will gather to:

🔥 Reclaim their God-given design
🔥 Step out of survival mode
🔥 Embrace truth without fear
🔥 Find purpose in faith, family, and freedom

And the lineup of speakers this year so far?

Trust me -- these are America's boldest, most beautiful truth-tellers:

# [I'll never stay quiet in the face of antisemitism](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=193367050&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkzMzY3MDUwLCJpYXQiOjE3NzU2MDI4OTcsImV4cCI6MTc3ODE5NDg5NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kPpsul0DWJS6JT0GgAHSC0oF0QETTQ8KTCw5IZ8nuO0)
### Our Jewish neighbors deserve to practice their faith without fear.
Apr 7
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..WzzqzsTGLRRgLjlS1tN7-YhMhP_wFdyRu90hTQw7mqU?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/ill-never-stay-quiet-in-the-face?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
As Jewish Americans across the country celebrate Passover, there's an elephant in the room that we need to talk about: _antisemitism_.
Just a few short weeks ago, Michiganders were brutally reminded of the threats that our Jewish neighbors face every time they enter a place of worship, attend a community event, or gather with loved ones.
The attack on Temple Israel in West Bloomfield was an act of senseless violence that should serve as a wake-up call to all of us that we must do more than simply condemn antisemitism.
We must be willing to be courageous in taking action to root out antisemitism everywhere - because it shouldn't be like this.
No one should have to live in fear of violence for simply practicing their faith.
**Every Michigander deserves to know that the leader representing them in the U.S. Senate is someone who will stand up for their right to live and worship safely.**
I've made my position very clear. It's upsetting to see that one of my opponents is campaigning with someone who has a long track record of antisemitic and hateful statements, including that "America deserved 9/11."
Meanwhile, Mike Rogers is surrounding himself with antisemitic right-wing extremists, and we need to make sure that the candidate Democrats put up to face him is someone who can actually say that they stand by the Jewish community and against antisemitism in every form.
**Enough is enough. Our Jewish neighbors deserve better. And I 'm going to spend every day that I'm in Congress fighting for your right to worship safely and freely.**
In solidarity,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

Peter,
**“A whole civilization will die tonight.”**
That’s how Trump started today — by threatening to end an entire country of 90 million people. _Tonight._
I have to ask: Democrats, are we seriously going to let this happen?
**We now have people like Alex Jones, Candace Owens, and Marjorie Taylor Greene all calling for the 25th Amendment.** People who have been hardcore Trump loyalists, who have defended him at every turn, and helped deliver him back to power.
When those people are the ones sounding the alarm and calling for Trump’s removal from office, we have to stop and ask ourselves what the hell is going on. _Everything about this is insane._

I am reminding them of that again today. Trump is dragging us into another Middle East quagmire. In doing so, he’s shredding our alliances around the world, isolating America, and making us less safe. That is unacceptable, and I’m not scared to go toe to toe with Trump and his lackeys to protect America and our interests. We have to redouble our efforts to flip control of Congress and put an end to Trump’s recklessness and cruelty. If you agree, will you stand with me as I work to flip the House and win back political power? If so, please rush a donation now. U.S. Strikes Kharg Island Overnight

The U.S. military carried out [dozens of strikes](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2OhSAUhJ8GOwwggreg2MbubrulOcrxehIEA_5s9uk33mRfYLuZYmbyzddzeAIFiq9PWNFNJw0--WHPx7oVyhA9gg8UkcqSjlwGJZThQnNhhxgGWXk3edOoCp20tjVCd6arFodmnKdWieZhbDt3rfRT1_kGpNGjFCNU5O4moYVVTaOVqWUrWnhYg1p2M84z0-LYPOxY6inFgvmEnU6kGNOtUqyntFbBLfu-FdZ8MNUz1V_XVc_pO-J1x1am-kAn8tsz1b-x-I3F_7g4lQwY-JLyevxw2DIFbqvs_HZRCFSMZVq8VqDwHtz_8dHp1G8AAAD___6UeF0) against military targets on Iran's Kharg Island late Monday night, a senior official told [Fox News](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGSrCAQheGnwWyspkXAgOAmZnPTDSlG2pmuQrCE0X38rdlH2Owk5wv-r7u_B06cn__DRm452ccSfTve2175CDlSiIkzcX2V91E9AuobqBsYn5OXXXRL1AN25KQxowZlte1ezhr9iBInsGEkMAvCGkHbhwSYHhOMHbuPBAoMDoNC3csRxjAZTUraldZVKHjvMTSq_VJypeMMjU_inMtnldwvZeuSe7W2VzH8EzgLnK_r6tfynen63DaB88mRisBZDxNqi8M4SYnd4eJ-cUpctREKnlvg9Au2PzQ4Hf4EAAD__xE6aVQ). Targets included bunkers, radar stations, and ammunition storage — but not oil infrastructure. The strikes came hours before President Trump's 8 p.m. EDT Tuesday deadline for Iran to [reopen the Strait of Hormuz](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2upSAUhZ8GOw1u-dGCYhq7M-2UhgOb454oGECdx594k_sCt1vFl5W1vj-v5WVpo_j5bXc07qLFJ7_UfO5HoWyjR-s3ikhlTWcuC3BQLRct10vclr7xxnk1QIOm11oqLkY1NqvhUoAefOhBT28-KeddsCFMSqF6OykbMk8TF1zDMAhQXS-5tJNWKPoxYAhM8PPwtmLpXIoF82UrXUgxpiel2Lm0N5tZaz0KG34xmBnM9313ty0rxU9NEf_ZnSLmB2UwR7zLw6xUsV3TWZDBLGQv-TgxmP_69rLRYfv8bh3agoEytt8KGMxNNv64aduoKM0E_-yWtq8h9QfuLgP_AwAA__9GsX-G) or face a bombardment of bridges and power plants. Trump wrote on Truth Social Tuesday morning that "a whole civilization will die tonight, never to be brought back again," adding, "I don't want that to happen, but it probably will." ★★★
Vance: 'Ball Is in Iran's Court'

Vice President JD Vance said he is [confident Iran will respond](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2upSAUhZ8GOw1u-dGCYhq7M-2UhgOb454oGECdx594k_sCt1vFl5W1vj-v5WVpo_j5bXc07qLFJ7_UfO5HoWyjR-s3ikhlTWcuC3BQLRct10vclr7xxnk1QIOm11oqLkY1NqvhUoAefOhBT28-KeddsCFMSqF6OykbMk8TF1zDMAhQXS-5tJNWKPoxYAhM8PPwtmLpXIoF82UrXUgxpiel2Lm0N5tZaz0KG34xmBnM9313ty0rxU9NEf_ZnSLmB2UwR7zLw6xUsV3TWZDBLGQv-TgxmP_69rLRYfv8bh3agoEytt8KGMxNNv64aduoKM0E_-yWtq8h9QfuLgP_AwAA__9GsX-G) by tonight's deadline, speaking at a press conference with Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán in Budapest. Vance acknowledged the strikes on Kharg Island but said they do not represent "a change in strategy." He revealed he had received a [text from envoy Steve Witkoff](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2OhSAUhJ8GOwwggreg2MbubrulOcrxehIEA_5s9uk33mRfYLuZYmbyzddzeAIFiq9PWNFNJw0--WHPx7oVyhA9gg8UkcqSjlwGJZThQnNhhxgGWXk3edOoCp20tjVCd6arFodmnKdWieZhbDt3rfRT1_kGpNGjFCNU5O4moYVVTaOVqWUrWnhYg1p2M84z0-LYPOxY6inFgvmEnU6kGNOtUqyntFbBLfu-FdZ8MNUz1V_XVc_pO-J1x1am-kAn8tsz1b-x-I3F_7g4lQwY-JLyevxw2DIFbqvs_HZRCFSMZVq8VqDwHtz_8dHp1G8AAAD___6UeF0) during the presser but declined to share details. Pakistan's Army chief was reportedly in contact "all night long" with Vance, Witkoff, and Iran's foreign minister as [ceasefire talks](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1yhCAQx58GOxxEBCwo0thd2pTOnqznThAc4DSPnzGPkGZni__X_L4e8wMoUHx9wo5uOWn2yc81v_ejUIboEXygiFS29M5llkJqLhQXZo5h7hrvFq972aDrjBm0UFbbZnPWroMd1DjY0RtYV9AWxlUqPyrzNMI05O4koYSRfa-kbrtBDDAajaqzK64rU-J9eKhY2iXFgvmESidSjOn-UmyXtDfBbbUehfUfTE5MTtd1tc-MVJ-Q661gctrJ-4AcoVQmp7uWyUmo-xgmp4xHyrVw_DlCKpRi4RtC9hwq_94gvziVANHzG0fhS6ZKCwSeKNyelCsvVJHJqcnOHxeFQEUbpsRrBwp_M-s_yJ5O_gYAAP__5-CJig) entered what Tehran called a "critical, sensitive stage." ★★★
Spanberger Approval Craters

Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger's popularity has [plummeted to record lows](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGyniAUBOCn0Q4HEcG_oEhjd9OmdI5w1DNBYAA19-0z5hHSbbM7O9-vr-ULyFPYf8KJxt60uOiWmq8zFcoQHILzFJDKEa9cFsGFYlwyrpfgl751xjo1iBZNr_WouJzU1B4Gh0ELDVqMk-UDWrda-elXrcbJaes-LZl3iUuuxTBIobp-5CN8tELZTxtuWyP5lRxULJ2NoWC-odKNFEJ8UwydjWfrzVFrKs3woxFzI-bnebot_gn4vLWzEXOKnirZ0og54MNS9J5lvBF8YSVBWDHvmAtLMV0eMtVvBic5toL97aEcLN6Y2Y45f58vR6awt9m49JD3VJRuJN9PIP_vT_0PwtuIvwEAAP__J5yFXQ) just two months into her term, with a new poll showing 47% approval and 46% disapproval — the worst early numbers for a Virginia governor since the 1990s. One independent voter told the [Washington Examiner](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LEOnDAQBNCvMR0nsxibFC7S0F3alGjP3oOVjG3ZBvL5EfmEdK8YjUbz-72-kQPH7RceZN3Fq09-beU8cuWC0RP6wJG47uksdQUJupeql2aNYR06b53XI3RkB2MmLdWs526346Ad0KwdmUmj-jg16q93NMNHg3LUsX2apJIGxlGBfg2TnPCH0aSG-Uvfr1DyzB4b1ZdLsVK5sPFFHGN6lOLLpaMLdm8tVzH-FLAIWO77ft1Yd45bS5H-4MGRyhMVsES6q4DF4ZGRt_i4NmwkYFHTYAYzC1jwwxty6GvG-KGyUenrmXMqrXcFG5Xa5xSCgKUr1uebQ-CqjVByO5DDv1XtP468LPwNAAD__2UbhQQ) she's "just a bot for the Democratic Party." Her support among independents has cratered from 59% on [Election Day to 45%](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGyniAUBOCn0Q4HEcG_oEhjd9OmdI5w1DNBYAA19-0z5hHSbbM7O9-vr-ULyFPYf8KJxt60uOiWmq8zFcoQHILzFJDKEa9cFsGFYlwyrpfgl751xjo1iBZNr_WouJzU1B4Gh0ELDVqMk-UDWrda-elXrcbJaes-LZl3iUuuxTBIobp-5CN8tELZTxtuWyP5lRxULJ2NoWC-odKNFEJ8UwydjWfrzVFrKs3woxFzI-bnebot_gn4vLWzEXOKnirZ0og54MNS9J5lvBF8YSVBWDHvmAtLMV0eMtVvBic5toL97aEcLN6Y2Y45f58vR6awt9m49JD3VJRuJN9PIP_vT_0PwtuIvwEAAP__J5yFXQ), as critics slam her reversal on gerrymandering and her decision to block state cooperation with ICE.

Democrats Remain Deeply Unpopular

Democrats' hopes of winning back control of Congress in November took a massive hit when a new [CNN poll ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD1uhDAUhE8DnZExYLOFizR0mzYlems_7z7Jf7K9kNw-IkdIN83MfPq-7vsdyFN8fkJAbQ7abbJ7K--QKxWIFsF6ikj1ld6l7oILyfjMuNqj38feamPlJHrUo1KL5PMq1_6l0TysWG5mtSOqVSnuFok4KoE35IvjPelric9ciWmahRzGhS9wUxLncXXoXDfzd7bQsA4mxYrlgEYHUozpSikOJoXe61druXbTRye2TmzneQ4ufUc8r1roxJaTp0amdmILZBuWwMBDCeyB3ldmMSRToFXmwCCrDTEzB0cq8CBP7YdZdGSoMYs1U0OGHs31z55AsfZF23yS91Sl6mb-DED-D639w-ahxW8AAAD__yNFiVA)found just 28% of voters view the party favorably.

★★★
RNC Chair: 'Very Few Races Competitive'

RNC Chairman Joe Gruters told [Breitbart News](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHS4yAMhJ8Gd8oQgsEpKK5xl2uv9CggJ7rB4AFsX97-xnmEv9GokHa_3T-P6YEcOb1-40LO7zyFHKZWtmWtXDAFwhA5Edd33kqdlFQGpAZppxSnaxecD-amOnJXa3sj9WCG7u00GY2DpieFYZbeU2_V3d5xlij9nahjdypJLa263bQyl2sve7xbQ_o6zDTPQsttDdioXnxOlcqOjXfilPK55XTxeemie7e2VnH7JdQo1Hgcx-VZiNsTSzsvhBp95LUKNZ6GQo1Sn6MXaqR_Pm6Vd4KSPPg3coG_meBVtkalwk7lAzMdUNBTBfRtwxg_4POyUuMTByp-KhwEIacGiShAy3BwAoT0xcT4fRdq7IoL68ExcjVWaPlakOM3RftB8btT_wMAAP__vvGV8w) that "very few races" are actually competitive heading into 2026, adding the party doesn't "need to win a national race" to hold the House majority.

★★★
Dems Push 25th Amendment, Impeachment

Democrats are ramping up calls for Trump's removal over his Iran escalation, citing both the [25th Amendment and impeachment](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0L-utCAQBfCnwY4NjIhaUHyN3X7tLc0IsysJfwyg-_o37iPc7pdMMifn_DzXJ_rg0_s_RjL28qvLbm3ljEf1BZMjdMEn8nXPZ6krCNBcKC7GNYVVds5Yp3voyMhxHLRQk5663ajNbjBLvUnaNu3ATZtE1w9o-36CATtv7k9CiRH6XoF-yEEMOI-alJxe9HoxJc7DYaP6sDlVKhc2f5FPKd_K6WFz7ILZWzsq6_8xWBgsbafdh3DfGCx7jpToU788KzFYhknOWs_cUcy2YKv825UXivnCwGHgGCm5SKlxHw9Cu99msHTFuOPjQ_BVj0yJd0T_TeraH4a7DPwGAAD__-w_fts) efforts with zero chance in a GOP-controlled Congress, but designed to frame the 2026 midterm debate.

Roy Unveils DHS-SAVE Act Combo

Rep. Chip Roy (R-TX) introduced a [sweeping new bill](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGuriAQhJ8GOwwioreguI3df9tbGmDX300QDKCe_-1PPI9wms2XzWRmMv9fy8tSoPj-Z3c0_qIFEiw1n_tRKNsIaCFQRCpbOnNZpJCaC8XFuMSwdA0YD7qXDZpuHAct1KSnZjNOTaCU693q0Q1D33c4TBqcAisBO9-QeZyEEqPseyV12w1isH9GjaqbVlxXpsR5gK1YWp9iwXzZShdSjOmhFFuf9iaYrdajsP4vkzOT833frctI1dlcHwWT85ECVfKFyfnJZHIW6jkP4ZcPZ6ELecaD5_ThFGtOcHos3FEI3KfdUaT45lpwsB8OW-HrGeF5FXshtztm8pZbX5mcm2zguCkEKnpkSrx3S-Gna_3FvJeR3wEAAP__jfaLuw) combining 60-day DHS funding with the SAVE America Act, aiming to end the partial shutdown while mandating proof of citizenship to vote — all in one legislative package.★★★
Reconciliation Route for ICE

Senate Republicans are eyeing [budget reconciliation](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGSpCAURb9GMyxEhDYg2MSsN93QouGprxZ5FKDO_P1U9ydMdoN7b506_57L02LAuP21Bxh34eLJLzWfRyqYbfRgfcAIWHY6c1kEF4pxybheYlj61hvn1SBaML3Wo-LyoR7tbqyQViutVK_G0U18BTcMkxOTs3yC19qieT9xybUYBilU1498tJNWIPvHCuvaSH4mbyuUzlEskC9b8QKMkd6JYufoaIPZa02lGf40Ym7EfN93t9JXhPs9OxoxJwpY0ZVGzBkS5Qq5sEgVXkT_2UaJwTcU5vfCPNjA1jN6jBtDByxlesGnzTIcdNlQWNnP6umOzGe7lTYbn24MAYvSjeTbYTF8yOovZF5G_AQAAP__UA-IvQ) to fund ICE enforcement and removal operations without Democratic buy-in, but the approach risks sidelining other GOP priorities, including voting reform and war funding for Iran.

★★★

Republican patience with the Iran operation is growing thinner as the [60-day War Powers Resolution](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2u4yAURlcDnSO4_KagmMbdm3ZKi5jr-EoYLIOd7Y-cJbzuSJ90pPP9-5l-ImUq779xwzBfNKWapn6c297oiCVhTJkKUlvrebQJBNhB6EG4qeRJ8hTmZBVwDNI5Y4X21vM1uGeMRhqH0lilvLKvpwJjrFcvbU1aOIXbJLRwoJQG-5BGmPh0FrX0Cy4L0-LcU-zYHnMtDY8rdrqQSqk31fKY68ZzWHvfG1N_GIwMxr7iSjnfG4NxrRsW_LQvng0ZjMZLbw0Md9vwrvvwTWUw8iOk_UM5U7OOafHeIn09vP_ilivA_wAAAP__Mydwfw) window approaches. Sen. John Curtis (R-UT) wrote he "will not support ongoing military action" beyond the window without congressional approval.

Normally when writing these emails, I try to approach them differently from the other political emails you’d typically get. Peter, this time is different, so I have to be more direct:
**[I’m reaching out today with a last-ditch request for a contribution of $5, or anything you can spare now.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8545?t=8&akid=972%2E124072%2E6t-hYj) That’s because, just yesterday, the Senate GOP’s leading super PAC pledged to flood the North Carolina airwaves with $71 million in attack ads to lie about my record and keep this seat red. **
To be clear: It is not normal for the GOP to write such massive checks seven months out from Election Day.
This time, they know North Carolina is key to saving their majority. They know the polls show our opponent within striking distance. They will spare no expense to prop him up.
Though we knew these attacks were coming, we’re now facing way more outside spending _way earlier_ than we had expected. That means we’re going to have to ramp up our fundraising in order to fight back and set the record straight – and Peter, that’s where you come in:
**[While Republicans can easily direct their megadonors to drop tens of millions of dollars into this race, I’m relying on hundreds of thousands of folks like you – giving what you can, when you can – to compete in spite of their efforts to buy this seat out from under us. Now that you’re up to date, can I please count on you to chip in $5, $25 or anything you can spare right away to help me fight back?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8544?t=9&akid=972%2E124072%2E6t-hYj)**

I didn’t run for Senate to sit quietly on the sidelines. I’m a mom, a conservative, and a proud Alabamian—and I came to fight for the values that make America strong.

_**Faith. Family. Freedom.**_

The Left is doing _everything_ they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

Their voter registration staffers are at their tables right now. Their ballot chasers are making their calls. Their door knockers are hitting their lists. _And if we are not doing the same thing — right now — we are falling behind._ **I know this because I've lived it.** In 2024, my team spent over a year embedded on the ground in Pennsylvania before Election Day. We helped register hundreds of thousands of new Republican voters. We chased down every outstanding mail-in ballot we legally could. We drove voters to the polls on Election Day. **That is why Pennsylvania went red.** Not because of any law. Not because of any court ruling.
